The flight was on time and I would use them again.

title: Porter Airlines customer review
author: R Martelock
content: This was my first experience flying Porter and it won't be my last. From the moment I got to the Ottawa airport to check-in I was pleased. The agent at the counter was friendly and helpful. She proceeded to inform me of my departure gate and where the Porter lounge was and to help myself to anything I wanted. Onboard the attendants were helpful and attentive once in the air we were served a box lunch wasn't expecting this at all (considering it's only a 45 mins flight from Ottawa to Toronto) and a beverage of your choice. Arrived at Billy Bishop airport in time for my connecting flight to Windsor.

title: Porter Airlines customer review
author: S Kean
content: Windsor to Ottawa. Windsor airport lacks services in general. The Porter staff were friendly and check-in easy. The lounges in Ottawa and Toronto were quite comfortable and it was a plus to have the free Internet access. The snacks are certainly an upgrade from anything offered on other carriers and the flight costs were far more affordable.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: A Storey
content: LAX-BNE-AKL. Great service from flight crew. Lie flat bed with topper was OK and comfortable but not as good as more modern seats. Had single seat 5J which is great if traveling alone. New First lounge in LAX is very nice. Quick hop across Tasman in 737 with always friendly Kiwi crew.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: George Whyte
content: Flew Business Class from Melbourne to London (with stop over at Dubai). The first and longest leg was dreadful. The female cabin crew member who was demonstrating safety procedures just scowled. Not offered much to drink. Man next to me made his bed flat and strapped himself in clearly not wanting to be disturbed. I sat watching the rather small screen entertainment and closed my eyes occasionally. Was I asked if I wanted a meal? No. When I realised I had missed food I was told service had finished so had a whisky instead. Business Class? We weren't able to land in Dubai so circled for a long time before diverting to Bahrain to refuel. Waited there and flew back. This added over four hours to flying time. I was given one can of ginger beer in that time (and that was offered with a scowl). The seats were all right but nothing special. The service was diabolical. In many years of flying all across the world this cabin crew was one of the worst I have encountered and did nothing for the reputation of Qantas. On the second leg Dubai to Heathrow however the cabin crew were polar opposite: friendly and helpful. Food was nothing special though. I used Qantas with great expectations and found it wanting.

title: Norwegian customer review
author: C Rudbeck
content: Flew Norwegian's 787 "Dreamliner" Premium Economy from Fort Lauderdale to Stockholm. In spite of the teething problems one reads about our flight exceeded all expectations. Boeing has developed an aircraft with cabin altitude pressure and lighting seems to diminishes discomfort and jetlag. Seats were more comfortable (foot/leg rests) than many other airlines' business class seats. The service by all Thai flight attendants was superb.

title: Norwegian customer review
author: G T'to
content: I was scheduled to fly on the Norwegian flight to Stockholm from Ft Lauderdale on Dec 21. That flight was canceled due to an aircraft problem. The flight was rescheduled for the 22nd at 12.00 which would get us to Stockholm at 3.30 in the morning. To make a very long story short the flight was canceled at 5.30 and it now looks like we will be leaving at 2 in the morning! The staff were friendly enough but no one knew what was going on and we were poorly informed. Never again.

title: Norwegian customer review
author: David Fisher
content: Norwegian long haul never again. My flight from Bkk to Stockholm Arlanda was cancelled after a 12 hour wait at the airport. Very bad customer service for information and I had to call many times to Norway until I got answers about my onward journey. No representative at hotel and no message sent to phone or email until the day after. Had to spend 1 night and 1 day at hotel waiting eventually I was found a seat with Lufthansa via Frankfurt. I will never use this company again.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: Leonnicol Maeda
content: Took this flight from SFO-MNL non-stop. I chose this Airline because it was a non-stop flight and I didn't have to worry about transferring my luggage during a connecting flight. Flight attendants didn't smile a lot. It seemed that they looked very tired of what they're doing. Meals were fair but nothing special. The seats were okay but not very comfortable for a 14-hour flight. IFE was very poor. My headphone jack was broken and I could barely hear the movie I was watching. It turned out that the jack in my seat was the problem. Also not all the lavatories were in a working condition. 2 in the middle were out of order 1 lavatory at the back produced a strong odor of cigarette smell. Not all the amenities were complete.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: Andre Krummacher
content: BKK-MNL-TCL-MNL-BKK in December January and April. While the international flights were largely on time (usually delays of about 30 mins) PR does have a horrible on time record on domestic routes. The TCL-MNL flight in December and April was delayed by 3 hours I was lucky to made the BKK connection (rushed in minibus over the tarmac from T3 to T2). On all three trips the MNL-TCL flights were delayed by 1 hour. The excuse is always "late arrival of aircraft" which they claim is beyond their control! Food on the international flights is inedible I rate it the worst airline food I have come across. On my last MNL-BKK flight it was freezing cold - passengers complaining. However they only had 20 blankets for 100+ passengers. I guess I need to look for alternatives.

title: Porter Airlines customer review
author: T Goh
content: YQM-YOW-YTZ. Check-in was easy at YQM with polite staff. Bright airy cabin clean-smelling inside the cabin comfortable leather seats with generous space between each row. Professional flight attendants because of a quick turn around at Ottawa before continuing to Toronto we were served food and drinks twice. Both times we were given a box containing a sandwich a salad and a piece of chocolate candy plus the drinks service. Even though it's not warm food its tasty better than pretzels and appreciated on a short flight. The flight was smooth and we landed in Toronto 20 mins ahead of schedule.

title: Porter Airlines customer review
author: S Walia
content: Round Trip from Chicago to Toronto and back to Chicago. They have a very nice lounge in Toronto which I got to experience when flying back to Chicago. Free use of the computer internet free snacks juice etc. The airlines really tries to take care of you in terms of making you comfortable. My flight was only 1 hr 30 mins and they gave out snacks. Great value for money with nice extras provided.

title: Porter Airlines customer review
author: B D Dudley
content: Porter from Chicago Midway-Toronto. Excellent trip best flight we've had in years. Staff was good plane with just two seats each side and lots of leg room for normal size people. Lounge in Toronto very nice with free beverages snacks and WI-FI.. There is a free shuttle to the Fairmount Royal York Hotel which is a central location.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: M Clarke
content: Flew QF1 SYD to Dubai - Very disappointed with this trip. Seat was uncomfortable and narrow. No pre dinner drink now only a welcome cordial. I pre ordered dinner and it was overcooked and barely warm when served. It was tasteless and simply the worse airline meal I have experienced. The arrival refreshment in to Dubai was average. The entertainment system was good. The crew were indifferent. Most didn't seem to want to be there and did very little on this flight. Overall was expecting far more from Qantas especially after experiencing the improvement within the domestic business. I transferred to an Emirates flight (Qantas flight number) and they are certainly miles ahead of Qantas. I am due to fly Qantas to America later on in the year and I am not looking forward to it. Would not recommend Qantas for an international flight in economy.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: F Kleinen Hammans
content: QF 98 HKG-BNE on new interior A330. My first flight with Qantas and very pleased. New seats have top notch entertainment system and a foot bag underneath the seat in front of you which I found brilliant. Crew was very warm and accommodating I went into the galley mid-flight for a snack and the FA heated a muffin up for me in the oven. I found the new meal service without the trays refreshing. 3 healthy choices for both breakfast and dinner I for instance had an excellent duck noodle salad. 5 different wines on offer! Only downside I found was the outrageous 25 AUD$ charge for seat selection. But will absolutely fly them again when in the region.

title: Norwegian customer review
author: Gatos Spyros
content: SXF-ARN one way flight. Excellent flight nice and friendly crew prices ok. It was a short flight but still there was some inflight entertainment. Definitely recommended.

title: Norwegian customer review
author: Glyn Redgrave
content: Checked in at Alicante no problems there. Spanish immigration commence boarding through the gate at 20.35 for a 21.15 flight. I go through the gate into a corridor just short of the aircraft to find a locked door where all passengers are queuing. It is in this corridor that we all wait 30 mins in for no apparent reason but it soon becomes clear. 10 mins before the flight is due to take off 2 of the cabin crew appear forcing their way through the queue clutching their bags from the duty free shop in the terminal. They then go through the door to the aircraft and boarding the plane begins. There was no apology from the crew for delaying the take off or leaving us standing in a cold corridor for 30 mins. I do not like being treated like cattle. This was my first and last trip with an airline.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: L Ball
content: Never again! We flew Bangkok to Manila. Manila to Cebu and are flying tomorrow Manila to Bangkok. All 3 flights have had the times changed and quite considerably. This is not normally an issue but we have connecting flights. The worst being our flight tomorrow from Manila to Bangkok. It was originally at 14.15 arriving at 16.45 perfect for our connecting flight at 20.45 so we have time to clear immigration and re-check in. Then it was changed to 15.40 arriving in Bangkok at 18.10 which is just about OK for our 20.45 flight bearing in mind we must clear immigration as it's a different unlinked airline booking. Then today the day before I go online to check in (a good job I have) and our flight has been changed to 17.50 arriving in Bangkok at 20.20 which is impossible for our connecting flight. The best PAL have offered is a 'free' change to the 09.35 flight arriving in Bangkok at 12.05. We now lose half a day in Manila and we had planned to do our souvenir shopping then and we now have 8.5 hours at BKK airport. Yes we could go into BKK but we've visited BKK many many times before (we only live in Laos an hour away). I am not impressed. How can an airline change all 3 flights we've booked?

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: C Estrella
content: I came back from Manila on March 31 2014 on flight to LAX. As I boarded in NAIA on March 31 2014 the first attendant did not make any courteous comments whatsoever. Her response was rude but I tolerated it because I chose to fly cheap. PAL's Business Class is around $4.000 cheaper than Cathay Pacific and PAL flies direct. Service was not bad and all facilities were working. On our previous LAX-MNL flight the reading light above me wouldn't switch off and like other reviewers have said nothing was done about it. On this leg we paid the $50 for extra leg room in economy and ended up behind the main door with the big hump thereby preventing me from extending my leg forward. We can fly CP or JAL or SA and pay a lot more plus spend more time in the air and on layovers or we can just pay PAL their cheap fares and hope that the next PAL plane we board is newer.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: Aeron Aquino
content: LHR-MNL-LHR. I had to fly to MNL for an emergency. I couldn't get any flight on the usual airlines I fly with specifically Star Alliance member airlines or Emirates. A PAL flight suited my schedule so I booked a flight with them. I was not sure of PAL when I did the booking as it is fairly new to the London market though it is the only airline that offers a direct flight to between LHR and MNL. The day of the flight came. I did a web check in with no frills. When I got to the airport (LHR T4) the longest queue of passengers waiting to check in got my attention: all PAL passengers on the same flight I was about to be in. Luckily I checked in online so I did not have to wait for hours. PAL does not have its own ground staff hence was outsourced with DNATA which Emirates owns. When I got onboard very friendly FAs assisted me and changed my mood. Service really is great may be the same as Singapore Airlines' service. Food is average had 3 services all throughout the flight. Inflight entertainment is good though as not extensive as Emirates' ICE. No complimentary toiletries in flight unlike Asiana. Seats are wider and comfortable unlike seats on Singapore Air's A380s. On my way back to London I am impressed with the service at Centennial Terminal that PAL exclusively uses compared to Terminal 1 which is stressful. The flight was the longest flight i have ever been into - 15 hours. The service was great. In total PAL LHR flight is good value for money and will fly again with them. Hopefully PAL will have its own ground staff at LHR as DNATA staff do not care and gives bad impression on PAL.

title: Porter Airlines customer review
author: C Fox
content: A 40 min flight from Windsor-Toronto took 6.5 hrs. What a disappointment. Spending so much money on advertising and not ensuring customer satisfaction is a waste of your resources. Toronto is very sophisticated and smoothly operated. Some compensation should be offered more than a $12 luncheon voucher. I am very disappointed. Next time I will be driving to Windsor not flying Porter.

title: Porter Airlines customer review
author: V Foo
content: Toronto-Chicago. Incoming aircraft was delayed due to weather from departure city. Aircraft was boarded at 8:10pm. Flight is further delayed. Reason scheduled flight crew cannot exceed 14 consecutive hrs of flight time. Aircraft is de-boarded and passengers must wait for a new aircraft and flight crew. No updates. At 10:10pm was offered a small box of refreshments. Contents: 1 cold muffin and a yoghurt. At 11:00pm announcement was made. Flight is cancelled. Next flight tomorrow morning at 9:00am. No offers for a hotel or cab fare. What was stated by the ground crew "we need to clear the building as quickly as possible because the last island ferry is at midnight". This is the experience from a first time passenger of Porter airlines.

title: Porter Airlines customer review
author: P Rubenstein
content: Montreal-Toronto. Morning flight. The night before there had been weather related issues that disrupted the positioning of crew and equipment resulting in cancelled and delayed flights in the morning. It happens and one cannot blame an airline for that. However the ground communication was not good. Porter has a problem in providing updates at the best of times. Although I received an email I was already at the airport when it arrived. I noted that the flight crew was at the gate and one of the additional delays was due to there not being a flight plan issued for the already delayed flight. I am usually a big fan of Porter's inflight service but the service on this flight was poor. All I wanted was a glass of water. The FAs forgot our row and the one behind us. Minor issue but when added to the flight delay and poor management of the situation it put me into a grumpy mood. It was my worst Porter flight experience. Porter is the preferred commuter line for business travellers and on this day it successfully encouraged a great many to consider the alternative Air Canada service into the airport. I hope Porter improves as I do like the airline but its slipping bit by bit and will see this reflected in the loss of passengers as they return to the AC shuttle flights.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: L Sun
content: QF18 (JFK to SYD via LAX) and QF431 (SYD to MEL) on 2015/05/18-20. Despite the fact that both of the first two legs of the trip delayed by more than an hour we were kept relaxed and calm by the nice cabin crew who helped us rebook our connecting flights. Nobody onboard actually complained about the lengthy delays. However I soon discovered I was on an older B747 aircraft the entertainment system was difficult to use onboard as it wasn't a touchscreen and it crashed often. The whole design of the interface also resembled an old computer operating system from the 1980s-90s. There was also not a lot of choice of movies compared to the QF A380. When I was watching a movie it got stuck quite often. However despite all this I have not lost faith in QF as a preferred airline.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: Paul Williss
content: QantasLink Perth to Darwin via Alice Springs. 717 on this route managed to score exit row seat. First leg you get lunch which was Thai beef wrap and cookies then second leg hot dish. Food nice enough service very good flight on time.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: D Angelevski
content: I regularly travel on QF497 Sydney to Melbourne. I choose this flight as it is the last flight to Melbourne and I can take advantage of a whole day in Sydney. Being a late departure the Qantas Terminal is always quiet so check in and security is a breeze. Qantas gate staff are forever pleasant and welcoming. Onboard depending on which day you'll fly in a 737-800 or Airbus A330 aircraft pushback is quick and before you know it supper is served attentive crew and always on time. Highly recommend this flight for any late departures back to Melbourne.

title: Norwegian customer review
author: Adam Denman
content: Flight DY 1336 SVG to LGW. Announced 2 hrs delay. No info no excuse no apology - nothing. After 2 hrs they announced another 30 mins delay. Again no info. Staff had no idea what was happening. Badly managed. Zero communication.

title: Norwegian customer review
author: B Cheetham
content: This was our first experience with Norwegian Air we cannot fault them in any way. We arrived late at Edinburgh Airport for our flight to Copenhagen we were accepted for Check In we were so grateful as we only had a weekend break booked. The plane looked quite new very clean plenty of leg room the Cabin Crew were very nice. Would not hesitate to use them again.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: Gloria Pineda
content: 3/8/14 we were denied to board our flight from Basco to Manila due to the strong winds. 10 passengers were bumped off including us. Reason given was they needed to reduce the weight of the plane. No assistance were given to find accommodation or a flight out. Told to go to the PAL office in the town and speak to a PAL agent there. The agent offered us a ticket on a flight 2 days later even though they had a flight next day. We were forced to buy tickets from another airline to be able to fly out next day.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: R W Langhorne
content: We fly PAL regularly from San Francisco London and Tokyo to Bacolod. In January after a meeting in Manila we were to take the 12.30pm flight to Bacolod - which PAL was charging a premium for. Six hours later we arrived in Bacolod at 7.45pm. No offers of a meal premium ticket refund or any customer assistance. We are trying to find alternative airlines to fly. It should be noted however that inflight service has always been good.

title: Porter Airlines customer review
author: D Brynen
content: Montreal to Toronto. Friendly crew and ground staff and super comfortable plane. I was most impressed with their lounge in Toronto with all the freebees.

title: Porter Airlines customer review
author: Joe Graves
content: Very poor performance and communications by Porter at Toronto. After telling us the inbound flight was in the air they kept delaying the departure time over and over. 4 hours later we were still not gone. First time on Porter and last time ever. Lounge is nice but no real food - cookies is not good when flights are delayed.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: D Lobo
content: Just done a trip from Sydney to New York on QF11 and return to Brisbane on QF 16 in business class. The aircraft from Sydney was meant to be an A380 but this was switched to a reconfigured 747. Was a bit disappointed but the crew and service was great on both legs. I think Qantas must have done some retraining as they were friendly efficient and happy to be there ( which hasn't always been the case). Lie flat seat was comfortable and I was able to sleep well Food was tasty on all legs the menu variety was worthy of business class. Crew topped up wine regularly. Would recommend Qantas this time although it is expensive.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: G Ron
content: QF93 and QF11 MEL-LAX-JFK 14/5/2015. Everything about this flight was impeccable. From information to passengers about the short delay ex MEL through to the professional and attentive service by all crew encountered both flights were close to full it seemed. I'm 6ft and had no problem with my economy seat so can't really understand other peoples comments regarding space issues. Just ensure you do your seat exercises and wander around periodically. Only gripe were the transfer procedures at LAX that needs a rethink so it's not a bun rush. All in all a rather peasant 21/22 hour experience. Hope it's the same on the way home.

title: Norwegian customer review
author: R Ryan
content: Flew on the first flight from Fort Lauderdale to Oslo on 29th November. Check in at FLL was very quick and the staff member very friendly. Boarded on time but left about 20 minutes late with no reason given. Inflight movie selection was excellent. Seats are a bit hard but amply space between seats.

title: Norwegian customer review
author: Andrew Ratcliff
content: I flew Norwegian DY7005 Stockholm - JFK. The flight was an hour late departing and the gate crew did not update the waiting passengers through an announcement or an update to the status screens so none of the passengers knew what was happening. I spent about $70 in extras (food mostly) and still spent less on the flight but the experience left me feeling "nickel and dimed". The aircraft was a 787 Dreamliner and I thought the seats were more comfortable than most. The entertainment system was solid but had a poor selection compared to the United flight I took on my way to Europe with about 3X the selection. The big windows made it possible to see out from the middle section of seats. The staff did not seem to be well trained and the lighting and sound systems changed abruptly.

title: Norwegian customer review
author: A Tønnesen
content: From Alicante to Bergen on Dec 7th-13. As always: an attentive crew relaxed and efficient and with a touch of humour. Also good and reassuring information from cockpit about turbulence delays and the like. Tidy cabin and toilets leg-room ok. Web page and ticket reservations excellent. On-board WiFi very good. It's obvious that the airline over the years has put much emphasis on building a robust passenger-friendly culture. Given the recent press coverage about salary-cuts and increase of working-hours I think it's impressive that the crews keep up the good work as always. From long flyer-experience with Norwegian I've never noticed any negative fluctuations of the service-level.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: Michael Daugherty
content: I fly LAX-HKG twice a year and am still wondering why my company got tickets with PAL. Starts off 12hr delay at LAX. Every 2 hours they would bump it two more. I live about 30 minutes from the airport and would have gone home if I had known it was going to be 12hrs. Then to add salt to the wound when I landed in HKG and they had lost my luggage. At least they got my luggage to me in Shenzhen about 40 hours later so I feel fortunate. Food and crew were very nice and no complaints there.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: Sharrett James
content: Flew from Singapore to Manila. Last group to get on locker space over my seat was full with other passengers excess baggage they had to find a space half way down the plane! Airline should only let 1 carry on the rest should be checked in. Staff didn't care. Flying out to CDO plane was 1.5 hours late taking off same problem again my locker space crammed with other passengers baggage had to put my bag under my seat.

title: Porter Airlines customer review
author: Raymond Dyke
content: The staff and the service amazing we just flew to Halifax from St Johns Newfoundland. It was prompt and very helpful staff were fantastic offered help and anything that we need we a deaf bowling team and they treat us just like anyone else.

title: Porter Airlines customer review
author: Thomas Bell
content: An excellent flight over the Easter weekend from Ottawa to Toronto - the lounge in both airports are great and a pleasant surprise to those used to flying Air Canada economy. Ditto for the free lunch on Easter Monday. Excellent service throughout the entire journey - I'd fly with them in a heartbeat.

title: Porter Airlines customer review
author: Fadi Barakat
content: When the destination I am going to is covered by Porter I do not hesitate to book my flight with them. Good things about Porter - lounge at YTC is amazing no waiting in line at security in contrast to YYZ-T1 on a Monday morning. They handle fragile Items in a remarkable way. Downside - not very nice staff when checking in luggage. Expensive over weight and extra luggage charges.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: Paul Williss
content: Darwin to Perth on 737-800 with winglets. This flight time has never changed leaving Darwin at 2.20pm and with the 90 minute time difference gets into Perth a bit before 5pm. Flight is always fantastic. The cabin crew are always great food is top notch plus flight is long enough to watch films. Oh and they always serve free wine and beer. Nice for a mid-afternoon flight of nearly four hours. There is always a choice of mains - had a very nice soy chicken dish with vegetable fried rice. Still all the nice little sides of bread roll and butter cheese and crackers and as it was Easter Saturday a Lindt Easter Egg. Nice touch! Mars Bar ice-cream later on. Can never fault this flight one that I have flown now for twelve years. Always look forward to it.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: Heather Camm
content: I have used Qantas frequently and always been satisfied but QF161 Sydney-Wellington on May 12 was disappointing. The meals offered were a disappointing choice and the lamb/broccoli that I thought sounded the best was terrible. The 2 people sitting next to me didn't eat theirs either! The cabin crew were very attentive but their English was very hard to understand and not what I would expect on this flight.

title: Norwegian customer review
author: S Cooper
content: Flew Malaga to Munich Monday 2nd December. Could not print out boarding pass so stood with all the hold luggage folks at check-in. On the plane the staff hid behind a curtain and told my wife off for waiting for the toilet inside the curtain. Drinks came round eventually but not offered a second one on a 3 hour flight. Today 6th December arrived early at Munich to catch flight to be told it's delayed from 9pm until the following day at 6.30. As I write this am not yet on the flight so we will see. However the compensation for 9 hours at the airport was just food and not other help offered. Claimed adverse weather was to blame but at the check in desk this evening the Oslo flight was boarding so they have abandoned a non hub flight to support a flight but to Norway. Norwegian claimed via their handling agent that everyone got an SMS which was clearly untrue as others we spoke to had not got any update for a travel delay.

title: Norwegian customer review
author: Tønnesen Audun
content: Bergen to Alicante. The flights with Norwegian are always the same I mean: the overall ok quality of the product is very stable. The cabin crew are very relaxed efficient and friendly. Norwegian is very serious about safety regulations in the cabin and the crew enforces the rules in a friendly and helpful manner. While the "nordic" idea about service may lose out against an Asia-based airline the advantage shows aboard a low-cost airline like Norwegian. You may have to wait a few minutes until the crew's free to serve your coffee you may have to stand in line a few minutes for the toilet to be vacant but the crew really work to make the best of it and you notice!

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: Sebastian Tirol Leahy
content: I went on it last summer 2013 with my family from Hong Kong to Manila on an A320. Cabin was clean cabin crew were friendly comfortable seat but poor entertainment system. The food was good and no delays were required. I recommend this for tourists to the Philippines for holidays. It's much better than Cebu Pacific.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: Todosychuk Ken
content: Here we sit in Manila airport waiting for our 2.35 in the afternoon flight to Puerto Princessa. It is now 5.45 pm. No compensation offered no excuses offered they do not care they are extremely disorganized we will never use this airline again. The staff working at the customer service desks had no idea what was going on as well as being too busy on their phones to even look up and address us.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: J Martin
content: MNL - Puerto Princesa - MNL flight using a PAL Express A320. Crew was courteous. Pilots and crew spoke fluent English. Complimentary snacks. No flight entertainment as this was a domestic flight. Both flights to and from were on time.

title: Porter Airlines customer review
author: Jennifer Li
content: Toronto to Montreal. The check-in was simple and waiting lounge was amazing with comfy chairs free drinks and snacks as well as free internet. The plane seats were leather and wide free snack and alcoholic drinks also a plus.This was definitely a great experience and I would definitely fly Porter again!

title: Porter Airlines customer review
author: M Kyle
content: I used to be a huge Porter Airline fan but recently I have found that their service has gone downhill. They've canceled 3 out of my 4 last flights at the last minute (presumably because the flights were not full and they wanted to consolidate volume on a less traveled route) leaving me stranded. Their call center was rude and unhelpful when I tried to rebook - such a contrast to the service I received when calling to change reservations just a year ago! I'd recommend avoiding Porter at least until their service and reliability improve.

title: Porter Airlines customer review
author: Eric McLoughlin
content: I just returned to YSB (sudbury) on Porter having flown them 6 times since December for personal and business travel. I can easily book a flight with a discount that they offer and get a meal and a drink. Every meal has been different and staff are very good.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: Ian Hughes
content: Just completed a return trip to Singapore out of Brisbane so not a long flight. This is my fifth trip overseas and first with Qantas. I don't believe I will be doing anymore trips with Qantas because they simply do not come close to the competition airlines such as Thai Airways or Singapore Airways. Price is on par but service comfort and food quality is no comparable. I have no idea how others have rated this airline so highly.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: L Sun
content: I was surprised to see all of the negative reviews of the long haul service. I did not experience anything like what was written in those reviews. Flew QF93 MEL-LAX (A380-800) on 2015/05/11. Quite pleased with the service for the most part especially with the cabin staff I was treated very well. Every time I had an issue with something I called and not once did they refuse to assist me. The food was okay although I did not like some of it.

title: Norwegian customer review
author: V Rosendahl
content: CPH-LGW-CPH in B737-800. Clean cabin and pleasant crew outbound as well as homebound wifi functioning above flight level 300 as announced. Food & beverage still on the expensive side however that's up to the individual. So far my three round trip flights on DY have been smooth.

title: Norwegian customer review
author: Robert Taylor
content: My first trip with Norwegian today and impressed. Low cost ticket but beats the other two major low cost operators hands down. Aircraft presentation first class Crew all wearing a professional looking uniform and provided excellent service a credit to the airline. Wi-fi availability on board the flight made such a difference. I will certainly be looking to see if they fly routes to any future destination I may choose if so will certainly book Norwegian.

title: Norwegian customer review
author: Lise Omdal
content: OSL-BGO. Punctual - arrived a little earlier than scheduled time. Aircraft (737-800) brand new. Free WiFi. Seats OK but not too much legroom. No drinks or snacks (it's only a 45 min flight) available - nor for purchase. Staff friendly. Only one seating class (all economy). Ticket fares very reasonable compared to other airlines.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: J Casaol
content: Paid for 20 domestic flights for a big family travelling within the Philippines and had at least 2 flights delayed by at least 2 hours (9 tickets affected) without any offer of stay i.e lounge access. Requested Lounge access as my flight delay would mean 7 hours out of hotel accommodation and 4 hours in airport but was told Lounge is for first and business class. No manager on customer service would talk to me as were too busy. Embarrassing as they are the national carrier.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: J Scarlett
content: Travelled Sydney-Manila return in business class. I was pleasantly surprised - the flight was very comfortable with excellent service comfortable lie-flat seats and was pretty much on time. The only real issue was the poor entertainment system best bring a good book.

title: Porter Airlines customer review
author: Michael Doyle
content: It takes you back to the days when airlines actually cared for the customers and they were not just a seat number. The cost of the flight was perfect for our budget. We took advantage of a 30% discount that was offered during Christmas time. They gave us the opportunity to choose the seat we wanted on the flight. The aircraft was clean and for it's size comfortable. The cabin crew were courteous. It was nice getting a glass for drinks rather than a can or a paper/plastic cup. They also provided a delicious snack during the flight. There was no extra charge for a glass of wine. Check in great - they have kiosks set up so it take only moments to check in. Pleasant waiting for the flight in a very comfortable lounge area and again provided with refreshments at no extra charge.

title: Porter Airlines customer review
author: T Stewart
content: I have used Porter for booking business flights for management and colleagues and in the past year we have had numerous cancellations of flights with very little or no notice. Porter should not claim to have so many flights per day to certain destinations when they cancel flights on a whim because there is not enough people on them. I would not recommend this airline for anyone using it for business travel unless they allow themselves a huge window prior to their first meeting or chances are they won't make it as their flight very likely will be cancelled and they will be bumped to later in the day.

title: Porter Airlines customer review
author: John Attersley
content: First time flying with Porter from Halifax to St. John's and return this week. Very good service cabin crew on both flights very professional. Check in staff at both airports very good. Flight from St. John's was delayed due to weather and received e-mail notice before heading to the airport so did not have to hang around the airport.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: W Coenik
content: QF29 MEL to Hong Kong on one of the refurbished A330. We were in Business class and the new seat layout of 1-2-1 is great. The new seats are very comfortable with plenty of room and storage space. We had window seats so sat one behind the other. This offers every other seat right up against the window with the storage on the aisle side and the other seats the opposite where they sit against the aisle (with the potential to be bumped) with the storage against the window. If you are a window viewer make sure you pick the right seat configuration. The crew were great but the lunch meal was below Qantas standard. I had fish and it was dry and tasteless. Their wine selection was great so it was the food part of the meal that was the let down. Entertainment was great and the flight was on time and drama free.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: Paul Brodie
content: I flew Qantas QF27/28 in economy to and from Santiago on the 8 October 2014 and 5 January 2015 respectively. The QF27 leg to SCL was fantastic. At the counter my oversize baggage was checked in without issue. The food was great and it seemed like every hour or so crew were coming around with desserts ice creams or drinks. The crew dealt with a drunk unruly passenger seated in front of me in an assertive way and the CSM disarmed the situation. The staff seemed to strike that balance of being friendly and getting on with the job in an efficient manner. As we approached Santiago from the south the Andes came into view on the right - definitely choose the right side of the plane if flying QF27! This would have to be one of the most scenic long-haul flights in the world and certainly gave an adventurous feel to the beginning of my 3-month holiday. Coming back the other way on QF28 I again had awesome views of the Andes from the left-side of the plane as we tracked very far south over Chile's Patagonian archipelago. One negative I would highlight is the price. The fare to South America is generally expensive so it's worthwhile waiting for a sale. I paid $2350 return but have a sale fare booked next year for $1600 in Jan/Apr. It helps if you travel a few weeks either side of Christmas. Staying on cost Qantas charges for seat selection. For me it's window seat or nothing so I didn't mind coughing up $25 each way but its worth noting that competitor LAN offers free seat selection. Lastly the entertainment selection is good but the provided headphones only provided sound through one ear. Combined with the roar of the 747's engines at the back of the plane I couldn't really settle into a movie as I was straining to hear the audio. I flew LAN's 787 within South America and the quietness of that aircraft made watching movies much easier. Something to consider now that LAN flies the 787 on the SYD-AKL-SCL route. On the flip-side its comforting to know you're on the tried and tested four-holer 747 as you cross the deserted Southern Ocean (and you don't need to make the stop at AKL making for a quicker flight).

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: I Klaus
content: April 10 QF10 Dubai to Melbourne. I have been a Qantas customer and frequent flyer for many years. On this particular trip together with my 9 year old son coming back from a holiday in Europe the disappointment with this leg of the flight was big. We been pampered from Frankfurt to Dubai by Emirates and then continued on Qantas back home. During this 13 hour flight the provision of food and drinks was poor. No child meal despite request one warm meal 11 hours after boarding before only snags and one pizza slice. No trace of the crew occasionally they pass through. The one warm meal was just one aluminium tray no sides. The service on QF10 was to be expected from a budget airline but here we paid well above the budget flights. Never again QF on international.

title: Norwegian customer review
author: C K Bourne
content: Gatwick to Lanzarote. My wife and I had a great flight no problems at check in no problem boarding. Good all round experience will be using them again next Sept in fact booking flights this w/end. Good job to all at Norwegian.

title: Norwegian customer review
author: S de Thierry
content: Alicante to Gatwick 31st October 2013. 21.15 departure. No Online Check-in which meant long queues at the airport for passengers with hand luggage only to get their boarding passes from the desks (no explanation as to why online check in was not available). However there were 4 desks open for just 1 flight which meant the queue moved quickly. Boarding process chaotic with people unsure which rows were boarding (unclear announcement poor organisation by gate staff) so only a trickle of passengers boarded for quite a while meaning the whole process took twice as long as it needed to. Other carriers have much more efficient and streamlined boarding procedures which Norwegian needs to learn from. Last 30 passengers to board had their hand luggage put in the hold because there was no more space in the cabin (no-one checked size of number of pieces of carry ons). Onboard seat pitch good seat comfort acceptable for a short flight. IFE shown on screens (cartoons etc). Free wifi available but extremely slow. Cabin crew very friendly. No pushy selling (in fact no announcements were made after takeoff until just before landing). Lights dimmed for people to be able to rest. On-time arrival. Norwegian on the ground are somewhat amateurs however onboard experience was very good. I would use them again but they need to improve their ground experience.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: S Bagsit
content: I flew to Manila Philippines with PAL last July 2013 and it was the worst airline experience I have had. The crew were not willing to help passengers. Inflight service was slow and did not even offer drinking water during the flight. I asked for one and the flight attendant said "in a while" and never came back. I will not fly this airline again.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: S Roland
content: MNL-HKG. Chaotic and long waits at Terminal 2. Very friendly check-in. Paying the terminal fee (not knowing why) is not possible to pay with credit card like in Terminal 1 and 3. Flight was delayed for nearly 2 hours. Staff onboard were very friendly few films only (compared to EK or TK) but very delicious food. Seats were ok! In HKG the luggage took a very long time to arrive. I will fly again with PR.

title: Porter Airlines customer review
author: Geraldin customer trasvel="left"〉
content: Hospitality and care is outstanding. Cabin comfort seats and leg room all appreciated. Check in than pleasant and accommodating.

title: Porter Airlines customer review
author: S Klass
content: Toronto-Newark. Great first experience with Porter. A hassle free getaway from Toronto convenient island airport downtown. I appreciated that all the extras like baggage wifi snacks transfers were free - I hope they don't change. The lounge was modern and comfortable enough with frequent updates on flights delayed due to weather. The cafe area in the terminal was a nice touch but was a bit messy when I arrived and the toilet needed a bit of freshening up too. Onboard cabin was clean legroom great service friendly and professional. Tiny onboard snack served and a real glass of wine. Can't complain. Good value great service on the ground and in the air. Something that seems to be a thing of the past for most of the big US airlines.

title: Porter Airlines customer review
author: S Lee
content: NYC to Toronto and delighted by Toronto waiting lounge. The airport is extremely convenient to downtown Toronto (arriving we walked to the new Thompson hotel. Returning we took a cab for about $8.) The waiting lounge in Toronto features seating for 2-4 people with small tables reading lamps and low screens so that every seating section feels semi-private. They also offer complimentary coffee tea sodas and snacks (nuts Walker's shortbread). I found the check-in and waiting experience convenient and pleasant.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: R Stuart
content: We flew to Santiago Chile in Jan 2015 by Qantas on Premium Economy. After having flown LAN several times in the past I have to take my hat off to Qantas for the quality of their service and their professionalism. It is rare nowadays to find good service when you fly around the world. Flights are usually packed and cabin crews leave much to be desired. The carrier a 747 was old but well maintained and upgraded.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: M Seton
content: Recently flew the Dubai-Sydney leg of our European trip on Qantas with my husband and 17 month old. I was so impressed by the friendliness of the crew particularly towards those of us with young children. Their attention warmth and smiles really made me feel comfortable and that help was at hand if needed. This was in stark contrast to the crew members of the other airline we took on our outbound flight and Paris-Dubai leg. The entertainment was good and included the favourite shows of my daughter which was a real plus. As airline food goes it wasn't fantastic but better than expected. I would book with Qantas over other airlines if I had the option especially when travelling with small children.

title: Norwegian customer review
author: Ralph Neil
content: LGW-ACE. Great flight times excellent value for money and comfy new 737-800. My wife and I travelled with Norwegian for the first time my wife is a wheelchair user and the assistance and courtesy from Norwegian was the best we have ever had. Seats were excellent I am 6 ft 2 and had more than enough leg room. Flight both ways took off on time and arrived early which is great. Will be booking with them again for next years holiday. Would recommend to anyone and in fact already have. Our crew were extremely polite and efficient.

title: Norwegian customer review
author: A Beswick
content: LGW-ACE. On time new 737s comfy bucket seats good legroom free wi-fi was brilliant and a real bonus compared to BA and Easyjet. Staff were great cant fault it. You can also choose any seat for free at the time of booking including exit rows.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: Jacek Zielinski
content: PR731 BKK-MNL Feb 27th. Online booking smooth as was online check-in. At BKK priority Immigration and lounge pass given direct down to THAI Business Lounge D. Far better lounge than the SATS that PAL uses at Changi. Onboard seated beverage requests taken asked for Champagne. 5 min later told they have ran out of Champagne. I ask how is this possible when we are still firmly at the gate. Purser explains PAL is not allowed to restock anywhere other than at home base in Manila. Since Feb 1st they are allowed to load only 2 bottles for Business class for 2 sectors. This A340 had 24 Business class seats 13pax. Outbound had 19 pax and all Champagne was consumed. Purser visibly frustrated by this policy but powerless. Same policy applies even to long-haul flights. Equally Economy is now limited to 120 cans of beer. Running out of Premium Class service items even before departure is ridiculous. This is regrettable because food was good and portions adequate and PAL Cabins Staff in Business is very friendly courteous and attentive. Seating was also comfortable as this was their long-haul A340 (Crew rest area in front Galley). Departure was delayed by about 20min arrival almost on time. Will fly again 2 weeks from now but if the same repeats itself I'm done with PAL.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: John Contreras
content: MNL-BKK-MNL. Flew last summer on an A340. interior are old entertainment is poor (drop down tv monitor only) boarding is delayed by 15 min only (no problem) take off is again delayed by 10 min (not fault of the airline). Flight crew robotic (not consistent with their domestic crew). Return flight is same crew are robotic and not warm but they are professional. PR lags behind other Asian competitor. Will fly them again maybe after rehabilitation is finished.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: C Reuben
content: Brisbane-Darwin-Manila return Mabuhay (Business Class) on Airbus A320. This is a very poor business class product. Seat was an old style recliner seat with a pitch comparable to economy class of other carriers. Seat reclines for about 2 inches and does not have any leg rest making it the most uncomfortable during a 7.5-hour journey. Entertainment is very poor no noise cancellation headphones and no amenity kits were given despite being advertised in the website. Service was attentive but food was very standard. Overall it was a very disappointing experience flying the Mabuhay Class product on this route. Unless they will upgrade their equipment the product is not worth the price.

title: Porter Airlines customer review
author: D Milicevic
content: Toronto to Chicago Midway was outstanding. I had to reschedule last-minute and had this done with no questions asked for a pittance. The experience at Toronto airport is civilized. Check- in staff friendly and the same number of agents (check-in and waiting lounge) would probably serve like 20 times more people at a regular airport. In the lounge free wi-fi espresso teas soft drinks munchables papers power plugs and fabulous views of the city. On the plane there was some tasty food and drinks served in china and glassware. And when we arrived our bags were waiting for us taken off the belt with handles pulled out. How's that for a nice touch? Plus the immigration at Midway is a breeze. I enjoyed the lack of commercial outlets around the airport - this is down to taste but do you really want to pass through rows of greasy spoon and faux haute couture establishments on your way to the plane? The only legitimate concern remains their apparent willingness to cancel flights.

title: Porter Airlines customer review
author: D Silverstone
content: EWR-YTZ return. Have not experienced flight cancellation/consolidation with Porter in three trips thus far in spite of having two flights being nearly empty! YTZ is immensely convenient and in spite of some lower fares to YYZ they rarely make up for the increased stress taxi fare and time that comes with flying into Pearson. Porter is much more stress- free. Good cabin and service for short-haul excellent ground staff in YTZ - nearly missed my flight and they managed to get me from the ferry to the gate in 5 minutes flat (do not recommend trying this intentionally however)! Good service and value but VIPorter frequent flier program needs work - coordination with booking system and check-in is poor (name on VIPorter didn't match passport name necessitating a few annoying calls). Also wish you could select a seat in advance.

title: Porter Airlines customer review
author: Brian Stamp
content: Very friendly staff in the airports and the plane. Planes clean and comfortable - only two seats per side. Web site good. Free snacks/sandwich and drinks for economy. Planes are turbo prop but modern and appear well maintained and running three flights a day from St. John's to Halifax.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: Phil McConnell
content: SYD-MEL. I don't think there is a single airline in the world today that can offer a domestic economy experience on a short haul flight as good as that on last nights QF477. Smooth flight comfortable seating genuinely engaging flight attendants excellent food and wine. Not the worlds most advanced IFE on this older B737-800 but I know most of the fleet is getting upgraded. The new hot food service box pack is excellent and the quality has clearly been improved- Coconut Chicken curry last night or a prosciutto salad. Nice to be offered a 2nd bottle of wine as well.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: P Gerner
content: Flew MEL-LAX and return on the A380 service in Premium Economy. After seeing some mixed reports this was a very pleasant surprise. The outward flight was on the upper deck which in Premium Economy had a bit more room and was a bit quieter than the return flight which was downstairs in Premium Economy. Both flights left and arrived right on time. In the A380 this is a very good product with the seating and comfort level almost the equivalent of older generation Business class. The cabin crew and the service were excellent the food good without being remarkable and the in-flight entertainment also excellent. This is very good value for the money especially if you book early enough when the prices tend to be lower. Compliments to Qantas.

title: Norwegian customer review
author: K Simpson
content: Flew Malaga - Gatwick great friendly crew modern clean aircraft. There wasn't the feeling that you were on a low cost carrier. Will use them again. I did feel the charges for food and beverage were a bit high.

title: Norwegian customer review
author: Havnegjerde Kristoffer
content: Fly Norwegian more or less 15 times a year return between various places. All but one has been excellent in regards to on time. Service and product has been very satisfactory. Nice clean cabin in comparison to other low cost airlines. Wifi is a bonus. Staff are friendly for the most. All in all a pleasant travel experience. Probably the best low cost experience in Europe as far as my experience goes. Great app for the smart phones available any gate or time changes it will alert you by SMS. I will try their long haul flights when it becomes available from Gatwick in 2014.

title: Norwegian customer review
author: M Prawdzik
content: CPH-LGW DY3516 on 15 October. As a nervous flyer I did not hesitate choosing Norwegian on this last minute booking knowing their fleet is modern and free wi-fi on board definitely helps to kill time during turbulence. As soon as I boarded the aircraft I let the flight attendant know I was experiencing strong flight anxiety to which she responded by giving me a bottle of water and offered me a less turbulence-prone seat in the front aisle row of the aircraft (before I was at the back in the last row). As soon as we took off other members of the crew constantly kept on making sure I was fine and when some moderate turbulence before landing occurred a male crew member sat by me and talked reassuringly. On top of everything the pilot made various announcements during the flight and communicated with passengers. These small things and professional flight crew contribute to the fact that I will definitely choose Norwegian in the future.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: S Sab
content: I flew Bangkok to Manila once a month for business for almost one year unfortunately I don't recall having one single flight on time. The average delay on this route is about 1-2 hours. Whether morning flight or late flight you face the same issue missing your connection no compensation nor accommodation arrangements. I am a gold frequent flyer on Air France China Eastern and Thai Airways from now on I am going to stay away from this airline.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: Mueller Martin
content: Flight from Cagayan de Oro to Manila plane was clean staff always friendly to the passenger. PAL is really a much better airline than the years before. Snacks coffee and water were offered. All in all a nice flight again with PAL.

title: Porter Airlines customer review
author: Karen Louie
content: I will not fly Porter again for business. They cancel and consolidate flights all the time - I've been the victim of this 2 of the last 3 flights I've taken with them. I almost got stranded in Boston overnight as they cancelled the last flight of the day on me. This past weekend they cancelled my flight again. I think this is because of low passenger loads. But they should not be able to claim say 10 flights per day to a destination if they cancel half of them. A free coffee in the Toronto departures lounge (no free coffee on your way back as there are no lounges in other airports for Porter) does not make up for my lost time and the stress of not knowing if I'll be able to make it home that night.!

title: Porter Airlines customer review
author: E Findley
content: On time departures quick no hassle check-in great in-flight service superb lounge pleasant in-flight staff - a delight. Baggage arrived at carousel in record time!

title: Porter Airlines customer review
author: S Stein
content: The fact they fly into Toronto's downtown airport saving the hour-plus commute is a bonus. Free WiFi coffee and cake in the waiting lounge pleasant staff free snacks and drinks on each flight (wine or beer on afternoon flights) comfortable seats on-time departures and a hassle-free check-in process make flying Porter worthwhile.

title: Porter Airlines customer review
author: A Boltwood
content: I enjoyed flying Porter out of Toronto into New York. Friendly staff and civilized service. The disappointment was flying back in foggy weather. My flight was redirected to Hamilton because the Island airport doesn't have good navigation systems for landing in fog and Porter's terminal at Pearson doesn't have Customs agents. Porter arranged buses from Hamilton to Toronto so they handled the situation well but the trip took much longer than planned. I would use Porter again for domestic flights but not rely on them for on-time arrival from the US.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: Val Henderson
content: BNE to Singapore. Checking in using machines just about everyone needed assistance. The seat allocation for my husband and I were many rows apart. Everyone ended up at the bag drop where this problem was sorted. A330 Airbus was cramped tired ditto the crew. Food less than ordinary no tray but just main meal container (one was cracked) plus roll and envelope with cutlery etc. Overheard passenger asking cabin crew member to recommend which of the meal choices - the reply was "Madam I would recommend eating before you board the plane"! The pre- landing snack was a sort of pizza contained in a thick cardboard box - made in England. Entertainment programme was minimal. Return flight fortunately on a rather more modern plane better range of entertainment but the crew were brusque uncaring and disorganised - would not feel confident about them in a crisis. Never again on Qantas.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: M Kamperman
content: QF 28 22nd April. Qantas experience in business class between Sntiago and Sydney was just excellent. Food was great seats brilliant and service was punctual friendly and professional. Can't fault Qantas on this service.

title: Norwegian customer review
author: P Halpin
content: Just travelled from Malaga to Gatwick very modern plane efficient friendly staff great having free WiFi. A very good low cost Carrier not all the constant advertising announcements like Ryanair. Great price would highly recommend Norwegian and certainly will travel with them again.

title: Norwegian customer review
author: L Hoff
content: Stockholm to Bangkok. Flight was pretty much on time and they weren't as strict with carry ons as other budget airlines but those are the only 2 good things I have to say. The plane was very old no WiFi you pay extra for food the ancient movie screens did not work for more than half of the 10 hour flight and the flight attendants were not helpful or knowledgeable at all. I would never fly with them again.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: Gallucci Charles
content: YQT-YYZ-MNL-YYZ-YQT in May-June 2013. I had flown through HKG and NRT to get to the Philippines in previous trips. So much easier to make one connection in YYZ rather than having to make 2 connections. Staff were good plane was very good. I paid the $20 for premium economy. Was a newer Boeing 777-300ER with a fair bit of room. (Pro tip: Sit on one of the sides not the middle section.) The warm cloths towards the end of the trip are a nice touch as I usually only get those when I fly in Business Class. Only complaint was not enforcing carry-on restrictions which can get out of hand. Ample baggage allowances. Terminal 2 is better than Terminal 1 but not as good as Terminal 3 IMHO but it's good enough and certainly not the fault of the airline. Immigration and Baggage was probably about an hour but again not the fault of the airline. Flight is overnight which means you arrive early the next day and can start your business or whatever immediately. I have another trip booked on the same route this May 2014 so yes I will be flying again.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: J Jones
content: YVR-Manila Dec 2013 return in Business class. As always the service was exemplary and we were made to feel welcome by the 2 crew members assigned to us. This was our third time in Business Class with PAL. The food was faultless. I do not know why people complain about their lie flat beds they are comfortable. The new business class lounge in Manila is a huge improvement and is very welcoming airside. The cabin on the 777 was spotless though there was an issue with my pillow not being clean as we boarded in Vancouver but this was changed. The purser approached me to apologise.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: S Osmundo
content: I flew business class round trip from LAX to MNL in January/February 2014. The 747 and A340 were older models. The service was excellent and made up for the older generation aircraft. The pilots were also very good with smooth landings. There was moderate turbulence on the way back to LA but the pilots handled it very well.

title: Porter Airlines customer review
author: Bob Meldrum
content: I had a chance to try their service in order to get to Chicago. The flight had a four hour stopover in Toronto but still it was outstanding in every way. The Border officer at Midway Airport was efficient but welcoming. Certainly much better than the experience I had had at O'Hare.

title: Porter Airlines customer review
author: D Howe
content: Return flight from Ottawa to Toronto. The lounges at both airports are a nice touch with high quality snacks and gourmet coffee. Outbound we got offered the same snacks as served in the lounge with our beverages. Complimentary wine was served in a real glass. Returning (same time of day) we got a lunch box with a half sandwich and cheese and crackers. I would still prefer to fly in a jet than a Dash 8. They claim it to be quiet but its really only quiet compared to other propeller planes. All in all nice service and a good product. But really 20 years ago all the airlines offered a snack lunch free drinks and in a jet. The Toronto Island Airport is a great location but it will be nice when there are some facilities before security to allow people to visit before going through security. One concern is that with the amount of overwater flying Porter undertakes using this airport on Lake Ontario (and now they fly to Newfoundland too) I would have thought that the seat cushions would at least double as flotation devices.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: J Dawe
content: Traveled Qantas economy to Bangkok on flight 23 returning flight 24 the overall experience was very average. Their new menu was terrible meals were poor and they are not anywhere near the quality of other full service airlines.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: Judy Morris
content: Apr 23rd Perth-Melbourne QF 772. Apr 30th Melbourne-Perth QF 485. I flew Qantas London to Perth 40 years ago and vowed I would never do it again after the most horrendous experience. My daughter booked this weeks flight for me and I was horrified to find it was with Qantas. I have now forgiven her following the best interstate flight I have had and am almost looking forward to my return trip next Thursday. The cabin crew were delightful and friendly. I had an excellent stir fry served with a smile and good wine for lunch and my seat had plenty of leg room.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: Matt Sammut
content: Melbourne to Perth return in the A330. Newer 330 was fitted with AVOD and the other older one with iPad's. Nice tasty meals both ways professional crew who were friendly and accommodating to all requests. Looking forward to the refurbishment of all the A330's in the coming year ahead. Will continue to fly Qantas as my first choice.

title: Norwegian customer review
author: Paul Samiec
content: LGW-GCN (Gatwick to Gran Canaria). Unfortunately low cost airline means in this case a lot. The price was ok but it's really showing what are you paying for. The seats are the most uncomfortable I have seen. If passenger next to you is a little bit bigger than the size of the seat then you are just stuck and pushed. Free wi-fi is a good advertising option but works very slowly. It takes several attempts to make anything work on Wi-Fi. Another rip off is the bar on board. They don't accept payments in Euros! Only credit cards and UK Pounds. The worst part of flying with Norwegian is the rude staff. It happened both ways: from London and back from Gran Canaria. There is a lot they can learn from EasyJet. If you a looking for a very basic flight without being fussy about service on board quality of seats and rudeness of staff then Norwegian is for you. Otherwise I will suggest trying some other airlines.

title: Norwegian customer review
author: J Tuomimaki
content: We booked a 3 week trip to Thailand and started our journey on September 7th from Oslo where our flight was scheduled to depart directly to Bangkok. Problems started immediately. Aircraft had technical problems and boarding was delayed several times. During the exhaustive wait information was given in Norwegian until the angry non-Norwegian customers demanded English announcements. Eventually the captain announced that the crew ran out of work time. We were taken to a low budget airport hotel late in the evening to spend the night and were told that we had to be back at the airport at 5 am next morning. We returned to find that the flight was delayed again to 8 am. They decided to give up fixing the plane and arranged to fly everyone to Stockholm in order to get on to a new plane to Bangkok. Naturally this required 3 separate flights to get everyone and the luggage there. Finally we took off from Stockholm towards Thailand after over 24 hours of waiting. Return flight had no more success than the first one. As I'm writing this our original flight from Bangkok to Oslo is already cancelled and there is no information whether Norwegian is able to get us back home somehow. Our original departure was scheduled at 9 am on Friday 27th and now it is 5 pm on Saturday 28th. Very unacceptable unprofessional and below any standards considering that we are living in the year 2013.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: S Simon
content: I have been flying MEL-MNL-MEL and SYD-MNL-SYD for the last 6 months. Initially PAL we're using 777 for both of these routes. Planes were brand new with lie flat beds in business. Since about September PAL have been using older 330/340 planes. Business seats are old and just a little better than economy. Business upgrades have been a waste of money on these. Service though has remained top class throughout the period.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: G Greenwood
content: Hong Kong to Manila PR 301 27 Jan 2014. A320 cabin was very confined and there was a long queue for toilets - was nowhere near as pleasant as previous flights taken in their A330. I will make a conscious effort to book PAL flights on their larger aircraft in future.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: M Cavanagh
content: Sydney to Singapore QF81- All new A330-300 seating. All seats in business have direct aisle access. The suites are not as large as I had expected but still very spacious and well appointed. Q-eat is an excellent initiative and I ordered my lunch online a week earlier. No hassle trying to decide what to eat when on board. The new lap sash belt meant I could have the seat in the recline position on take off. The staff were not totally familiar with all the workings of the suite so some staff training would be helpful when customers ask a question.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: Jay Kay
content: Flew Sydney to LA (QF11) and LA to Sydney (QF18). Was mortified by the unprofessionalism and lack of service by the cabin crew. Memorable experiences - I asked for water and was told to wait for the cart to arrive the cart did not arrive for upwards of 20 minutes. Later in the flight I witnessed a "premium economy" member's request for a second bottle of water being serviced. I guess you have to fly premium or business to be accommodated with this airline. On two occasions we were told the hot food ran out so we could only choose the cold food. Was also served burnt garlic bread. The tray tables were dirty and sprinkled with food / sugar particles. Heard a flight attendant audibly utter how "over the flight" she was. On QF11 the toilets were not cleaned regularly. Would not recommend or fly with this airline again.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: Reeves Tim
content: Adelaide to Canberra via Melbourne three flights on 737-800s one on a 717-200. With typical Qantas efficiency all flights departed and arrived on time and luggage was first off the carousel. Staff pleasant and professional. It's a shame that cost-cutting is so obvious - being handed a bottle of water instead of in a glass is so downmarket. And I do expect lunch and the offer of wine on a flight which departs at 11.45am and arrives at 12.50pm not a 'refreshment' and water again. But these are minor quibbles.

title: Norwegian customer review
author: V Hawkwood
content: Travelled return from LGW to Gran Canaria using this airline for the first time as they have great early morning flights ie 5.35 and 5.50. Check in both ends quick and stress free. Punctual take offs followed by enjoyable smooth and comfortable flights and added bonus of free wifi on board. Ground staff and air crew nice helpful and very professional. Also regular audible updates from the cockpit during both flights. This will always be our airline of choice in the future.

title: Norwegian customer review
author: D Hodson
content: LGW-BCN return. Given the price paid was expecting an ultra-LCC. Instead was pleasantly surprised by the modern fleet spacious interior reclining seats overhead monitors and friendly and professional service. Not militant about hand luggage which meant boarding was fast and easy. Free WiFi is a real bonus. Would go out of my way to choose Norwegian over their many competitors on this route.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: J Haveri
content: My husband and I traveled recently from LAX to Manila and back. We are vegans and had called Philippine Airlines twice to confirm our meal requests. On the trip from LAX to Manila we were served excellent vegan meals and the cabin staff were excellent. We had a problem on the return trip. We arrived to Manila airport 3 hours before our flight after traveling 2 hours from our resort. The business class lounge had no vegan or vegetarian food. We walked all the airport food concessions. Not one had any vegetarian food. Then we boarded our flight. The business class stewardess asked us for meal choices and when we said we had requested vegan meals she looked surprised. The Catering manager and his assistant came on board to speak to us to tell us to take the next day flight and the airline would have a meal for us. The only thing I can say is the business class stewardess was excellent. She did her best to find nuts fruits and remove meat and cheese from salads.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: G Lebo
content: YYZ-MNL-BKK on Jan 10 2014. 777 plane fairly new and very clean. Stop in YVR for more passengers and crew change. Then 13.5 hours to Manila. I thought overall the food selection was very good. Nicely presented and well garnished. Seats were comfortable with almost full flat. Was able to sleep and I am a fairly large man. Although the on demand entertainment system worked well I found the selection a little small and the movies somewhat aged The 3.5 hour flight from MNL-BKK was on an A340 that was showing some age. After take off we found the entertainment system did not work. Seems it was ok in economy but Business was not. The FA returned shortly with a stack of I Pads and gave them out. They had music games and movies. Really nice touch. The lounges in both YYZ and MNL were nice with food and WIFI.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: Castagno Mauro
content: I booked 2 domestic return flights Manila-Caticlan/Boracay-Manila and Manila-Busuanga/Coron-Manila. The first one that was also their first flight to Caticlan in the early morning was incredibly delayed whereas their bigger competitor was continuing to announce boarding and boarding to Caticlan/Boracay and to various other domestic destinations. My second flight (from Caticlan to Manila on 2nd January 2014 morning) was also delayed but not too big a delay. My third flight from Manila to Busanga on 2nd January 2014 (afternoon) was cancelled. My fourth flight from Busuanga to Manila on 6th January 2014 (afternoon) was cancelled as the third one. Canceling the above mentioned flights meant one extra night in Manila and one extra night in Coron Town (both paid by Philippine Airlines including return transfers and very small meals both for Dinner and Breakfast). Based on what I experienced directly i.e. my same (afternoon) flight from MNL to Busuanga was canceled also on 1st January 2014 on 6th January both flights from Busuanga to Manila were canceled it seems that at least during the first week of 2014 the route Manila/Busuanga-Manila was operated by Philippine Airlines/PAL express on a Best Effort way so beware! Based on my personal experience if you plan to fly to Busuanga then Cebu Pacific looks like a much more reliable option.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: M Moess
content: QF 163 Sydney to Wellington 8 April 2015. We missed our connecting flight due to the inefficiencies of Vietnam Airlines and Qantas stepped up to the party had ground crew waiting at the door of the plane whipped us of on the cart to the transfer desk booked the next flights to Wellington NZ. Extremely efficient well organised and very much appreciated. The flight was fantastic meals good quality and service attentive. (SYD-WGT).

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: J West
content: On flight EK 5566 February 6 Perth to Sydney my request for a non-lactose meal had got lost in the system. A hostess Veronica went out of her way to source a suitable meal for me to ensure that I did not go hungry. This was much appreciated and turned a potential disappointment into a pleasure.

title: Norwegian customer review
author: Honto Leung
content: I fly between Stockholm and London twice a week. I initially flew with SAS but their punctuality was outrageous. Tried BA just as bad so tried Norwegian. At first they were good but steadily the planes are arriving later and later. I pay on average £450 for a return trip economy. This is now the 3rd Sunday in a row where the flight has been delayed. Be interesting to hear the excuse for this week. Considering it is only a 2 hour flight delays of 45 mins are not really acceptable. To be honest all Scandinavian flights are a joke and they are all as bad as each other.

title: Norwegian customer review
author: Tiina Seppälä
content: HEL-CPH-HEL 16 September 2013. Booked my first flight with Norwegian and it turned out to be my worst air travel experience. Low cost airline service: paying for every little service (baggage seat selection drinks) separately is not for me. I cannot recommend to anyone. Wifi didn't work.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: D Mosley
content: Melbourne to Manila. Aircraft was an old A330 (scheduled to be an old A340 - normally a 777 though). Lounge in MEL is the Air NZ Koru Club lounge - one of the better lounges in Melbourne. Initially delayed for 2 hours due to late arrival of inbound a/c then further delayed by 1/2 hr due to technical problem. Bussed out to plane. Inflight seats are old. Do not recline much - no lie flat beds here. Luckily its a day flight. Service was quite good. Meal was average. Luggage arrived as expected. 4/10 overall.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: C J Toledo
content: Business Class from Manila to Tokyo and the only issue I had was their inflight meal portion size. There were two options of either Chicken or Fish I decided to have the fish and the portion size was ridiculous for a business class meal. I am no way a big eater but for a business class flight this should be looked at. The 2 pieces of fish were smaller than a matchbox with only 2 string beans and 2 roast potato balls. I have flown with Singapore Airlines and their business class meal portion size is worthwhile. The solution was - I had mentioned this to the inflight crew and they had offered me another meal which was nice of them to do so and they said they would report this to the catering department. Bottom Line: The overall service for PHP Airlines business class is good and staff are friendly. I enjoyed the experience and would fly with them again but I strongly suggest that the portion size for the business class meals are looked at and adjusted to a suitable size that's worth the fare paid. The overall experience was very good and the service was above average.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: Jim O'Hara
content: Sydney-London-Melbourne on A380 with a family group of six ranging from grandparents (includes me) to parents to two 11 year old grandchildren. Originally booked QF9/10 from/to Melbourne but QF9 was cancelled some months prior to departure apparently as an occasional cost-saving measure by Qantas. Hence we were moved to QF1 from Sydney for the outbound leg with a domestic connecting flight in Business. Overall an excellent experience that includes the chauffeur transfer services spa and massage facilities at the First Lounge in Sydney personal escort to the aircraft warm friendly and genuine personal greetings by all cabin staff and Customer Service Managers on each leg great menu options top wines and spirits good entertainment facilities spacious individual suites and very comfortable beds. All staff were magnificent - efficient cheerful always checking if anything else could be done and they had great fun interacting with the children (and vice a versa).
