They serve dinner and breakfast. The food is tasty and comparable with other Asian airlines. The B777-300 aircraft is spotless the legroom is ample the seat will recline and it has personal entertainment system with good selections of movies games and music. Overall PAL did a good job and I will fly with them again.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: C Figueroa
content: BKK-MNL business class on the refurbished B747. Flight on time. Meals were tasty. Legroom was ample and seat reclined to around 160 degrees. Asked flight purser to reserve an item for me from their duty-free upon delivery and she gladly delivered it to me right after a few minutes even before take-off. AVOD was also working and offered several options.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: S Fitzpatrick
content: BXU-MNL-HKG-MNL. Basically on time all sectors. As all sectors were 2 hrs or less didn't really miss fancy entertainment system. Cabin crew were good as was the food.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: M Forbes
content: QF511 BNE-SYD on a Boeing 737-800. What an enjoyable flight! For only a very short flight I was pleasantly surprised that seat-back inflight entertainment was provided with an excellent range of movies television music etc. The interior of the cabin was sleek modern comfy and clean with plentiful legroom and seating space. The FA's were professional and friendly giving us extra bottles of water upon our request. Really cannot fault the service on board. Breakfast was simple - just muesli milk and apple slices adequate for such a short flight. Only negative was that my headphones snapped after opening the packet but this was easily forgiven when the lovely FA promptly fetched me a new one. Without a doubt this was the best domestic flight I had ever taken! Would definitely recommend.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: B Stewart
content: Four QF sectors over Christmas/New Year AKL-MEL MEL-PER PER-SYD SYD-HNL. On all sectors the food and wine offerings were excellent although on our SYD-HNL flight the dinner service at three hours took far too long. First Lounge in SYD was chaotic but always is around the holidays. Cabin Crew service varied from outstanding to surly. Overall happy that we chose QF despite variable hard product and a couple of unpleasant crew who should probably reconsider their career in the service industry.

title: Norwegian customer review
author: Andrew Fleming
content: LGW-ARN return at the time of the pre Christmas disruption. Had booked non flexi tickets some time before for a reasonable price against SAS and full service alternatives - many offering poor connections. I am not used to budget airlines and as we were a family of 4 (2 small boys) I thought they worked out quite costly so I just paid to check a single case. Check in easy and quick. Outbound was delayed a little over an hour - no information volunteered within the airport I had to ask. Equipment was a 737-300 clean and quite nicely designed cabin. Food on board as others commented was expensive bordering on the extortionate and service seemed to take forever - mostly due to the time taken to process payments. I was overcharged for my order but this was rectified when I realised. Return flight was the first successful departure on the route in 3 days the airline had posted basic information on their web site but enough to convince us to make the 320kmtrip to the airport. Severe delays made us very late but check in staff understanding and helpful. In the event though we were only informed of a delay of about 2 hours after the check in had closed - this was attributed to problems at the London end so quite credible (again though information flow pre-boarding was poor). Overall - reasonable service for the money.

title: Norwegian customer review
author: Alan Mackenzie
content: CPH-FCO-CPH. Norwegian is one of the better no-frills carriers. Their web-site is easy to use and prices are reasonable for add-on extras - seat reservation checked luggage etc. Purchases onboard are very expensive however so you would be wise to buy any food beforehand. Our flights were on time the passengers dealt with in an orderly fashion and the aircraft very modern 737-800 series - clean inside and out. The cabin crew were friendly and professional. The only drawback is not being able to check-in on-line.

title: Norwegian customer review
author: S Holden
content: Oslo - Copenhagen and that takes an hour and a half. Our flight was delayed 2 hours and the gate was changed 5+ times. The only reason we knew about the gate change was because they sent texts to my boyfriend's phone; there was nothing on the tv screens to tell us about any changes. We couldn't find a service desk anywhere and when I did find a woman who worked for Norwegian she ignored me. Since there were no Norwegian service desks inside the airport security area I couldn't go outside the security area to see what was going on at the Norwegian desk. Check in at both airports was a hassle because staff were unfriendly and the check in Oslo was very confusing.

title: QantasLink customer review
author: K Pardoe
content: CNS-TSV. Missed flight due to late arrival of Jetstar flight from DRW. Advised to go to Qantas service desk at Cairns airport to obtain new flight details. Only took a couple of minutes to be booked on to next available flight. Received snack on 50 minute flight.

title: QantasLink customer review
author: Pete Hauser
content: BNE-HVB-BNE. Was a little irritated on the return trip that there was no wine offered despite departing at 35 minutes late at 1545. Legroom is satisfactory for a 45 minute sector. The snacks are on-par with mainline Qantas economy. Luggage was tagged appropriately for my connection to Qantas Business class at BNE. All-in-all QantasLink is doing a reasonable job on their short routes but I can't get past not being offered a glass of wine to apologise for a late departure especially 15 minutes before the bar service officially begins and even more-so since the full economy fare is almost the same as the BNE-SYD full economy fare on Qantas.

title: QantasLink customer review
author: B Williams
content: SYD-CFS: return flight on Qantaslink Bombardier Q400. Flight was smooth (despite inclement weather) and quiet. Food was very good and served from boutique style Australian food producers. Although I am not generally a Chardonnay drinker I would happily enjoy the Chardonnay served on the flight at home. Service was with a smile personal and efficient. Overall it was an excellent flight. A nice change from the plastic faced Virgin Blue staff and the magazines with Richard Branson on nearly every page.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: P Chambers
content: Flight 102 from Manila to LAX July 15 2012 returning home to LA from lovely trip to Thailand. We flew from Bangkok to Manila then Manila to LAX. First flight delayed by 5 hours which prevented us from taking the original second flight. The airline did a good job of trying to reach us about it ground staff in Bangkok did a good job of getting us onto a later flight and ground staff in Manila airport did a good superb job of expediting us from the first flight to the second which had been held for us and seven other people who had the same problem. It had been held an entire hour waiting for those last 9 passengers - with all other passengers on board and apparently no AC. Plane felt like a sauna when we boarded. From here it all goes down hill. This was the most uncomfortable plane I have ever been on. Very little legroom and the seats were unusually narrow so no elbow room. When the guy in front tilted his chair back it felt uncomfortable and intrusive. Food was average except for the fluffy cake desserts. Service was adequate some attendants were nice but others seemed apathetic. We would not choose Philippine Airlines again.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: E Carew
content: The new Boeing 777 on the Australia routes (serving MEL and SYD from MNL) makes a huge difference as it has AVOD. Flights were full in economy in both directions with excellent punctuality coming back but half an hour late or so on the forward journey. Overall a good experience.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: Eric Brian Roca
content: My flight from Iloilo to Manila and on to Los Angeles was really good. The food was good but the inflight entertainment was pretty bad. However I think they are getting new inflight entertainment so I would recommend PAL.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: G Wayling
content: Flight was London Heathrow (LHR) to Sydney (SYD) on the A380 both ways. I have to say this was one of the most comfortable long haul trips I've ever had to Australia. I think the economy seats on the A380 are as good if not better than anything that has been offered in economy before. I thought the staff were very good overall although a couple of flight attendants were not very friendly. The food is now largely served without trays which is fine by me. I thought that the food was mostly good especially the chicken salads offered on several legs. However I was a bit annoyed to miss some of the food which was delivered while most people were sleeping. I think they should perhaps deliver some of these things while more people are awake. I ordered the meal in advance on my Sydney to Dubai leg and this was a bit ordinary but overall I thought the food was decent. My main gripe with the service is that they no longer offer a complimentary toothbrush on this (very) long haul flight. I think it is a bit mean to deprive people of something with which to clean their teeth on effectively a 24 hour journey and I hope they reintroduce this again at least for this very long haul flight.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: Tony Laverghetta
content: SYD-MEL A333 and BNE-PER A332. I love flying Qantas and they never disappoint me. First flight was a short one of approx. 1 hour and still the magnificent crew managed to provide with a light meal soft drinks and good smiles. Departed and landed on time. Second flight was a long one from Brisbane to Perth on an old Airbus 330-200 domestic configuration. Again the crew was great they couldn't do more to assist us food very good great variety of drinks. The only negative comment was that we didn't have IFE however the day before the departure I received an email from Qantas apologising and providing extra frequent flyer points for future use. Can't wait to fly internationally once again.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: D Pugh
content: Flew Emirates from Sydney to Heathrow and return Emirates (QF Codeshare) Birmingham to Dubai and QF 2 from Dubai to Sydney. First time and last time I would ever choose Qantas. Received lunch about an hour or so into the flight from Dubai and then nothing until 12 hrs later when dried scrambled eggs and "sausages" were offered for breakfast about an hour out of Sydney. Compared to food offered on Emirates Qantas are way behind the 8-ball. Coffee was offered twice in 14 hours and both times cold and undrinkable. Qantas A-380 had far less comfortable seats as opposed to Emirates could not get comfortable the entire flight. Inflight staff did not appear to be pleased if they were asked for anything more along the lines of we were putting them out. I am ashamed to call them our national airline.

title: Norwegian customer review
author: T Mayer
content: London Gatwick - Trondheim. Completely ridiculous check-in system. You can't check-in online but at the airport you have to do it in a self-service machine. You then attach your luggage label to your bag. Then you stand in line for an hour to drop your bag off. What is the point? Stockholm - LGW no online check-in. Self-service check-in didn't work. But there were three people on the desks and the whole process was extremely quick and easy. B737-300 was extremely cramped even though the flight wasn't full. Sort out the check-in at Gatwick and I will happily fly Norwegian again. Good destinations and good prices.

title: Norwegian customer review
author: Paul Van Alsten
content: CPH-ORY B737-800. Comfortable leather seats with decent legroom. I paid for seat pre-selection - glad about it as flight almost full. Check-in hassle-free using the self-service machines. Food and drinks for purchase - a bit pricey. Informative cockpit crew very friendly and smiling stewardesses. I usually prefer Norwegian for the crew friendliness and the arrival in Orly - a much more convenient airport than CDG.

title: Norwegian customer review
author: Johanna Hoegner
content: OSL-DUS. For low-cost flights it is not appropriate to complain too much about the general services. It was ok on my flight. But the point is how Norwegian handles luggage in particular special luggage like in my case a bike. It already starts complicated when registering it at the call center in Oslo. Although they announce strict rules I was ensured to be allowed to use my producer-made soft bag for my folding bike. At the airport in Oslo you are told to go to the "special luggage" counter where a staff member wraps the bag with the bike in another plastic bag but not in a very careful way! Remembering the extra fee of €42 for the bike I was surprised to find it between all suitcases at the baggage claim in Düsseldorf and afterwards strongly damaged (deformed front wheel and chain ring). I couldn't find any Norwegian staff either in the baggage claim area or in the arrival terminal to report the damage. Trying to solve the insurance case on the phone again with Oslo didn't bring any solution about fair dealing either.

title: Norwegian customer review
author: S O'Brian
content: London - Oslo - London B737-800. Leather seats and designed so that leg room is much better than "old" seats. Check in OK but I still miss online check in. Buy onboard service a bit pricy in my opinion. Crew friendly both ways. Paid about 80£ for a return ticket which is very cheap. Airport express train in Oslo is very nice - but pricey.

title: QantasLink customer review
author: N Reeves
content: EMD-BNE Dash 8 400 one class cabin good flight with friendly attentive cabin staff who did all they could. Snack and coffee served (no alcohol before 4pm) seats were leather and comfortable for short haul but no recline. I am 6' and found there to be more than adequate leg room. An excellent service that other airlines could learn from.

title: QantasLink customer review
author: Roger Stone
content: BNE-HVB-BNE in Dash 8 300 and Q400 aircraft excellent flights. I would happily fly QantasLink all around Australia if I could. Superb service for short flights which were on-time despite poor weather. Excellent wine (free) on these short flights. Often the best service on Qantas family of airlines is the smaller internal flights with young and enthusiastic staff of QantasLink - they have an entirely better attitude compared with many of their long-serving senior colleagues on the long-haul services of Qantas.

title: QantasLink customer review
author: M Mihalic
content: Alice Springs to Darwin. Whilst no entertainment options I found the flight rather pleasant with a service that was that bit more personal than regular Cityflyer. The food was good and ample. Leg room was sufficient quiet aircraft and friendly staff made what would have been an otherwise average trip more bearable.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: Ram Drilon
content: MNL-YVR-MNL. The service is impeccable. Check-in is a breeze. From ground crew to cabin crew they were hospitable and assist you all the time. Long Haul Business Class is just smooth for nearly 12 hours flight and the entertainment is indeed good. Food is good though it needs more presentation.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: Bob Nell
content: Manila to Vancouver April 15 2012. Crowded flight-terminal hot and waiting area over flowing with passengers-long evasive pre-flight baggage check. Plane an old Airbus 340. Seats adequate. Entertainment system terrible with only three channels one so fuzzy could not watch it. Plane was hot and complained twice to no avail. Passenger to my left had a caregiver to attend to her and she blocked the aisle for 30 % of the flight. Staff were pleasant enough and food adequate. Prices have increased to the point where it is poor value for the money. I asked to be seated in the premium business section as I have been a Mabuhay member since 2005. I was refused and I know the section was almost empty. Will never fly PAL again to Canada.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: J Howsam
content: A380 London - Dubai Melbourne to London via Dubai. Paid A$90 for exit row seat on each leg which I think is reasonable and definitely worth it for extreme long haul. Although I chose row 79 which fronts a main galley and is very noisy I'd avoid this row in future. Food was the real surprise - Qantas have done away with all the dinner accessories (biscuits salad cheese chocolate etc) and instead serve much bigger main portions and they were actually amazing very impressed. IFE also very good. Around 100 Oscar winning movies going back to 1970 plus recent releases and full series of TV shows which is great. Overall very competitive full service airline - would recommend on the arduous Europe-Australia cattle class route.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: John Kneijber
content: Travelled Auckland to Brisbane 5th January 2015. Have never been a fan of this over-rated airline therefore I should have known better however decided to give them a go after getting a sale fare. Positives - smooth check in good customer service manager on board and ok food. Negatives - tacky lounge in Auckland service operated by Qantas subsidiary Jetconnect who operate a handful of 737-800s across the Tasman narrow body aircraft that have a premium cabin masquerading as a business class cabin seats that could best be described as premium economy crew who refuse to serve you 40 minutes before arrival because 'we are about to land' dreadful inflight entertainment on tiny screens with old movies old TV shows and old music. Back to Air New Zealand from now on. At least they know what customer service means.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: Lacey Heather
content: Paris-Dubai on Emirates then Qantas from Dubai to Melbourne. We were simply amazed at how wonderful the Emirates experience was. The Economy class cabin was very well staffed the cabin crew were impeccably dressed and couldn't have been more attentive. We were offered drinks early in the flight and they even had a brandy on offer! On the six hour flight we were asked twice more if we would like another drink. The meal was good for Economy and we got little extras offered like an ice cream. On the Qantas QF10 flight Dubai-Melbourne we had paid the extra for the exit row seats in economy but to our horror we were seated in 48 B and C so were adjacent to the cabin crew's work areas and kitchens. Note to self- don't book these seats again on an A380! While the Qantas cabin crew were very friendly but we were not asked if we would like a drink of any kind until quite a way into the flight and then it was a small glass of cordial out of a jug. Then we were given a beef wrap (not bad) in a box (no tray) which was the last I saw of any service until two hours from Melbourne when I was offered a banana. Mind you I was sleeping for a lot of the flight so it's unfair to criticise as I didn't really need service but what would I have got had I been awake I wonder? The meal offered at the end of the flight looked very poor and I opted for cheese and biscuits. Sadly we concluded that we wouldn't fly Qantas again on a long haul flight if we could get an Emirates option at the same time. Compared to Emirates it would seem that everything about the inflight service on Qantas flights needs a big shake up. Our national airline looks and feels tired and will struggle to compete with the Middle Eastern airlines for much longer.

title: Norwegian customer review
author: C Connolly
content: CPH-DUB and I would have no hesitation using them again. Flight on an older 737-300 but with new slimline leather seats fitted. Leg room adequate if not generous. Onboard service was slightly slow moving but with a decent variety of items to buy which seemed reasonably price and of good enough quality. Cabin crew were a little thin on smiles but frankly the same can be said of SAS. In fact flying with Norwegian is little different than flying economy shorthaul on SAS - and the price can sometimes be cheaper.

title: Norwegian customer review
author: J Jensen
content: Nothing. I had a flight from Stockholm to Copenhagen right on the edge of the initial airspace closure. No information from Norwegian. Once traffic is disrupted passengers are basically left to their own devices. Norwegian is certainly not going to do anything to inform them or help them.

title: Norwegian customer review
author: S Malt
content: We have been stuck in Oslo for five days and they have not offered any kind of assistance. We asked for food tokens or a drink we were told no and then received the most feeble sorry I have ever heard. Every airline is supposed to present a document to you showing you your rights which was not carried out by staff. As soon as we complained in any way we were met with a blank expression and a repetitive "no" to all our questions. I cannot describe how awful our treatment has been by this low cost airline.

title: QantasLink customer review
author: Roger Stone
content: MEL-LST-MEL on Qantaslink Q400s - excellent on-time and comfortable flights with hardworking flight attendants. Return late afternoon flight from Launceston offers free top quality wine plus a snack and coffee - better than some business class flights I have had on other carriers.

title: QantasLink customer review
author: K Roe
content: Perth/AyerRock/ Cairns on B717. Great legroom far superior to the others. Great service which on each leg included a drink and snack followed by a meal. Cabin staff very good. Pity I cant fly them on main routes. My only very small gripe is no entertainment options.

title: QantasLink customer review
author: Michael Little
content: Melbourne-Devonport return on the Q400. Pleasant flights friendly service and a tasty snack each time. The return flight operated 35 minutes late. The main let-downs concerned handling at Melbourne Airport. Qantas needs better signage to the bag drop counter for people who have checked in online. The QantasLink departure lounge is a dark and cavernous place. And the baggage from our flight was offloaded onto a carousel with baggage from two JetStar flights: people were milling 4-deep around the carousel trying to see their bags while the next carousel was not being used at all!

title: QantasLink customer review
author: P Garde
content: MEL-Devonport. Some 10 minutes after scheduled departure time a very embarrassed pilot announced that not a single checked bag had been delivered to the plane. After yet more delays we finally left some 45 minutes late. I regretted not choosing REX into Burnie instead of this carrier. On arrival into Devonport the captain stated he still could not find any explanation for this logistics breakdown at Tullamarine. (I assume it was industrial as unloading off my return Jetstar flight into the same terminal was extremely slow.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: Phyllis Wong
content: 3 flight delays in one trip! HKG-Manila-Tagbilaran City Bohol. For the first flight when we arrived the boarding gate there was no aircraft at HKG for Manila. We waited an hour for departure and arrived in Manila one hour later than scheduled. We asked the crews and interestingly they said the connecting flight to Tagbilaran city would wait for us. After we landed we rushed to transfer desk and were informed that the connecting flight had already departed. Subsequently the airline scheduled us for an early flight the next morning. Arranged shuttle to and from hotel. Return flight from Tagbilaran City to Manila delayed 20mins. When we reached the boarding gate for connecting flight back HKG we almost missed the flight with only 8 mins to spare. No one helped us through the domestic terminal to the international airport. However the flight back HKG was delayed again. Overall total: 25% on time rate!

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: K Robinson
content: I am waiting for my international flight as we speak and I have never been on such a disorganized airline! After passing several gates and several metal detectors and waiting in several lines I wanted to sit relax eat and wander around and shop until my flight. Unfortunately that is not happening because we had to go through an additional line baggage screening pat down and talk to more people at their kiosk! We could not have our water that we just bought inside the gate area and now we are stuck in a roped off area at our gate unable to go out and have lunch or a drink of water! I am so frustrated if only they had checked all of our stuff properly at the gate entrance there would not be this problem of waiting and not being able to leave. This is the first time using Philippine Airlines and I will not be using them again.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: L Reyes
content: CEB-MNL I was excited to try their Mabuhay Class onboard their brand new B777-300ER. I had a great time with them. Check-in was a breeze and boarding was smooth for business class. Seat was very comfortable and I could fly that seat for 16 hours with no discomfort. The B777 features an AVOD. Food was average though it was a pasta meal they served on business class. Landing was smooth as always. I will definitely fly them again.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: Heathcote Robert
content: QF 97 3 Dec 2014 and return QF 128 15th Dec. I have flown many airlines internationally and Qantas doesn't even come close. Poor level of comfort in business on the A380. Emirates business is first class compared to Qantas business. The meal (dinner) was ok pretty basic but after 2 hours in the Hong Kong business lounge I wasn't overly hungry. The service was poor. Not a lot of attention given to individual passengers. Awoken a full 2.25 hours prior to landing for the worst breakfast I have ever had. Filling out a breakfast order form ala room service is just an aid for the staff to get it over as quickly as possible in the morning. No other airline requires this just poor class. I was looking forward to the relaxing flight home in the flagship plane. Never again for me. No wonder the National Carrier is in trouble financially. 4 of us going to Europe in June yes with Emirates even though Qantas are now sharing the route. Be worth paying much more to go another airline even if Qantas are more expensive. Service with a smile..yes but not much service though unfortunately and definitely a cheaper all-round experience.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: Andrew Jane
content: Sydney-Dallas LAX-Sydney. A380 PE window seat across inside aisle back. All up a really good product and will definitely use again. Just a couple of minor quibbles reflecting concerns of others. The foot rest extending from seat is a bit of a waste of time. I am only 165cms and it was too short for even me. Also the seat recline perhaps goes back too far making access from window seat tricky resulting in a bit of arm rest gymnastics. I had no trouble with IFE or meal table with seat in front fully reclined as reported by others though. The meals were fresh and tasty close enough to business class quality. PE now shares washrooms with business on upper deck. Thought the queues would be bad but not the case after all. All up though it was the warm friendly understated service from Qantas staff that was the highlight. An 'upgrade' to business class for last hour of flight into Dallas so as to exit plane quickly for tight connecting flight was a nice touch.

title: Norwegian customer review
author: A. Hansen
content: OSL-CPH return. Ticket would have been quite expensive on this trip but fortunately I had enough bonus points to get a free ticket. Either way SAS` tickets were twice as expensive so no choice really. Used the self check-in machine on both OSL and CPH and had checked in and gone through security in no time. On the flight down to Copenhagen we flew on a new 737-800 which was spotless. Cabin crew was nice and friendly. The flight back was not so positive - a 20 minutes delay. Our plane was an older 737-300 and it showed signs of age. However the seats were new comfortable leather seats - not as clean either. The crew explained that they had chosen to try to have a short turn-around as possible and I guess that makes sense. Crew not as pleasant on this return flight but all in all it was a satisfactory experience and I almost always prefer Norwegian over SAS.

title: Norwegian customer review
author: M Thornber
content: LGW-OSL-TOS-LGW. Greeting and assistance at LGW by two Norwegian employees was exemplary and set an excellent first impression. Regrettably this was not so at bag drop (contractor). Cabin crew on all flights ambivalent and unfriendly. Norwegians own ground staff at LGW and OSL stand out as being good representatives for their company. Shame it doesn't extend to cabin crew.

title: Norwegian customer review
author: D Cameron
content: Dub-OSL. Normally I am happy with norwegian. This is not such a direct criticism of them but seeing as there is no way to add feedback or complaints to their website I hope they read this and act on it. Check in at Dublin was very poor. Sky handling partners had only one person to check in a whole flight (for at least 30 mins until someone else came and helped). This was very frustrating as there is no online check in you have no option but to stand in line and painfully watch the families and groups of travelers slowly check in. Flight was at least an hour delayed. Scheduled departure time 1220 actual 1345. Why do they lie to you at the gate and say expected time 1300 - totally unrealistic. As for the actual flight no travel updates from pilots along the way and not much of an apology for the delayed flight from FA's. As I said though this is the 1st time I have had anything negative to say. As for the previous comment about bags. I actually like the lenient approach to cabin baggage. This allows for me if I have a suitcase (which compared to Ryanair is very affordable especially if you wish to take 2 bags) to carry heavier items in the hold and clothes in a duffel bag on board!

title: QantasLink customer review
author: B Owen
content: MEL-LST on Dash-8. The 300 series not as nice as new Q400 due to vibration and cabin noise but comfortable seat with ample leg room. Warmly welcomed by FA with two crew serving a tasty scone OJ and hot drinks. 1/5th of the cost of other carries for this Christmas eve flight. Priority hand luggage accepted on boarding in Melbourne and handed back on the tarmac in Lauunceston with a cheery Merry Christmas would rate as excellent except for the older aircraft.

title: QantasLink customer review
author: Roger Stone
content: BNE-HVB-BNE superb evening flight on QantasLink in a somewhat small Dash8 200 Series. However this was ideal for a short 40 minute flight gliding over the northern beaches and Fraser Island and being served snacks and repeat serves of an excellent wine (as good as business class wines on many airlines) and all this for an economy airfare. FA attentive and very competent to get so much accomplished and provide good service for such a short flight. Return morning flight serves coffee with the same FA with good service. Flights all on-time with courteous check in service at the adequate regional Hervey Bay Airport.

title: QantasLink customer review
author: D Westral
content: Perth to Bundaberg return. Except for the wait at Brisbane (4 hours on return) was happy with the aircraft and the service. Loved being able to put our luggage on at Perth (and Bundaberg on the way home) and not having to check in again at Brisbane.

title: QantasLink customer review
author: Y Ren
content: BNE-HVB-BNE. Surprisingly good experience. Q400 was nice little aircraft during 50 minutes flight cake tea and coffee was served. Professional and pleasant cabin crews no Qantas club at Hervey Bay airport not even security check it was a little bit scary. In general it was really pleasant and surprising trip.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: J Urtus
content: Manila to Vancouver. The seat was ok not too crowded nice screen on the seat back to watch movies etc. The female stewardesses were rude with no please or thank you. I had no blanket when I asked the stewardess she told me if it wasn't on my seat it was too bad as there were no more. Aircraft was good  service staff need to be brought up to standards!

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: Geoff Mayo
content: Good food could have done with more liquid refreshment baby bassinet on floor meaning no legroom in bulkhead row reasonable AVOD IFE no airshow (map) on entire plane on return journey. Terrible terminal at MNL for arrivals (1hr wait for immigration 1.5 hr wait for baggage) terrible terminal at MNL for departures (cannot buy liquids airside despite going through 2x security lines little to eat few places to sit aircon broken down). I've flown with Cebu Pacific and PAL before and used all 3 terminals at MNL but this is by far the worst experience so far in so many ways.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: Bruke Lachowski
content: MNL to Tag Bohol. Flight on time flight attendants very professional and service was great. Quite expensive but I will definitely fly them again.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: R Hollows
content: BNE to LAX in December last year in business. We flew on one of the refurbished 747s on the upper deck and it was fantastic. The upper deck is definitely the place to be. I had expected to feel claustrophobic but it was surprisingly spacious. There were storage pockets everywhere the cabin was spotless and the flight attendants were relaxed friendly and very attentive. I didn't manage to get any sleep (never do on planes) but enjoyed the flight nevertheless and arrived feeling relaxed. The espresso coffee was excellent. For the return - the new lounge in LAX was bigger than I'd expected after hearing all the talk about it being cramped. We were one of the last flights out for the night but there were still plenty of comfortable seats available and the food was good. The lasagne in particular was wonderful.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: N Kiss
content: Its been a very long time since I flew QF internationally. Currently based in Singapore I've been travelling SQ mostly but a recent trip to London then down to Sydney then back up to Singapore I found the best pricing to be on QF business class. The A380 flight from London to Dubai was reasonably OK but only just. The A380 business class was very disappointing. The food and service was great but the seat and comfort was extremely average. I connected to Sydney in Dubai on an Emirates flight (QF flight number). Why would anyone fly Qantas on the same leg? When you are paying $8K+ for your airline ticket Qantas just doesn't cut it. The difference between Qantas and Emirates was extreme. Emirates was probably the best business class I've travelled on. Service and food was exemplary (despite the noisy Australia soccer team being on the same flight). But unfortunately it got more disappointing when I got on the A330 flight from Sydney up to Singapore. This just doesn't compare with any of the major airlines business class. It's simply not worth the cost at all. I was very disappointed but I will say the crew were great and the food better than Singapore Airlines. Qantas really have been left behind. I may get on another international flight but It would be my 4th or 5th choice and I would only do it if it was my only choice. Why people would pay the same price and fly Qantas when there is so much more to offer on other airlines is beyond me.

title: Norwegian customer review
author: E Irgens
content: OSL-AGP. Since they charge extra for checked luggage most passengers try to cram lots of carry-on in the overhead lockers. Bags that are way bigger than the limits given on our tickets. On arrival I found that my suitcase didn't arrive. How this is even possible on a non-stop flight is strange but Norwegians attitude to passengers with lost luggage is appalling. They do not answer their luggage enquiry line on weekend/holidays and their complaints department could only give me a number to their ground handling staff in Oslo. I've tried numerous times and waited on the phone for a very long time each time but got no reply. When calling back to Complaints to ask if they had any other suggestion the girl I spoke to got angry and slammed down her phone.

title: Norwegian customer review
author: G Isberg
content: CPH-LGW-CPH same day. Obama in CPH and snowstorm in GB caused major delays in both directions. The inflight crew were friendly and efficient. Lunch provided on the flight over and drinks on return free of charge to compensate for delays. The problem with these new airlines (in comparison to established ones) is when something goes wrong - for example major delays - because there is no representation at the airports to advise passengers. Called the airline to provide this as feedback. "I know" was the reply by the agent. Why doesn't Norwegian do something about it then?

title: QantasLink customer review
author: Michael Burgess
content: I recently travelled on a Qantaslink dash 8 300 Mel-LST service and found the service remarkable. I was greeted in such a friendly manner legroom was excellent considering the size of aircraft and snack service and the complimentary wine was quite unexpected for a regional service and flight time just over an hour. I have also heard that LST dash services are being upgrade to Q400 services can anyone comfirm this?

title: QantasLink customer review
author: J Storer
content: Weipa-Cairns. I could hardly believe the comments below about this Qantas Link route. I have been travelling this route regularly in the past year. It is usually late and often by hours. When delays occur there is no information available at Weipa airport and the Qantas call centre cannot tell you what is happening.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: M Binas
content: Travelled PR several times already both on International and Domestic routes and on both J and Y class. Impressed that no flight was delayed. Their new safety video catches one's attention. Food is not the best but not the worst one either. PAL may be a bit expensive compare to other local airlines but you get what you paid for.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: Raenard Llano
content: Cotabato (RPMC) to Manila (RPLL). I was not impressed nor disappointed. Flight delayed 45 minutes. The service was fine. The cabin crew were very professional very informative displays however their inflight snack was a let down. Aircraft was an Airbus A319. Although there was enough leg room the space is still so limited that you cannot go to the washroom without disturbing other passengers. My return flight to Cotabato was a little bit better. Delayed only 20 minutes the plane was Airbus A320 the snack was a little better considering they served coffee that day and the cabin crew professional as always. However the cabin was too hot.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: Peter Deeps
content: Travelled business class from Sydney to Darwin. Cramped and uncomfortable in biz. Light dimmed for sleeping but light from galley glared into passengers faces all night. Staff never tried to pull galley curtain and QF have removed the aisle curtain in their minimalist obsession. Staff appear disenchanted and struggle to appear genuine.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: J Rose
content: QF 127 HKG-STD in Premium Economy. In typical Qantas fashion they swapped out the scheduled A380 for an old B747 which made the trip miserable. To make it worse the entire P/E cabin filled with an oversold economy cabin overflow leaving the rest of their regular customers hung out to dry on Christmas Eve no less.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: Humphris Andrew
content: Decided to try Qantas for the first time on an International flight to Dubai on QF 9 & 10. Short answer - sub standard. Flown on Singapore Malaysian and Emirates over the last few years and Qantas is way behind the competition in terms of efficiency service and comfort. From check in were we were told that that we had exit row seats which turned out to be incorrect a 45min delay slow service both getting meals out and in particular clearing plates and you cannot get a scotch whiskey or a brandy and dry? Our baby bassinet looked more like a solitary confinement gaol cell when compared to other airlines and our young one wouldn't sleep in it due to in being very claustrophobic. First and last time I will be flying Qantas International.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: E Cabilis
content: MNL-PEK-MNL on an airbus 320. New clean with good legroom even in economy. No personal AVOD only overhead screens but a good movie selection. Both flights on time and inflight catering was good with ice cream served. Flight attendants very professional.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: Paul Wells
content: Hostesses were great the plane was clean and the food average. The entertainment was below standard on the flight from Melbourne to Manila I could only see a screen 8 rows in front of me in the next section. They need to lift their game to get more westerners to fly with them. If you want the whole package fly Singapore or New Zealand.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: Matt Buck
content: BKK-MNL-KLO return O/N in Manila on outbound trip. First leg non-refurbished 747-400 A319 on flights to and from KLO and A330 return to BKK. All flights were delayed IFE was on overhead monitors and bulkhead screen. Seat comfort was okay service was professional. Vegetarian Meal was tasty and drinks snacks and ice cream were served. Some passengers weren't given their meal preference as it had run out and were given what was left. Overall experience was not bad but not great either. I flew PAL for the scheduling and destinations and would fly with them again based on price and routing.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: Nicholas Janides
content: Melbourne-Perth-Melbourne A330-200 services. Two excellent and faultless journeys. The crew were really friendly and a delight to be around. I noticed that the food is getting much better. The thai beef with noodles and my Texas BBQ Beef on the return journey was tasty and very fresh. I have mostly flown with VA for business over the last 12 months and was happy to make another return to QF for my latest flight.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: W Burchell
content: Flight from Melbourne to Brisbane on old 737. Started in Qantas Club whereby food was good but kids section is in need of a very urgent refurbishment. Flight departed on time staff were all friendly and professional food was a hot meal and was an improved offering compared to recent pas. More taste and more of it. Arrived slightly early and bags were ready by the time we got to there. The down side to Qantas is the variation in the 737 fleet and we coped an old one with no personal TV which in 2014 is just not good enough.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: D Perez
content: Cancelled flight from Cebu to Narita and didn't tell the passengers until after 8 hours waiting in the terminal. Never offered any compensation. Plane left the following day like nothing happened and everything was normal. A truly non-caring airline towards customers.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: D Bendavid
content: MNL-CEB-MNL. No problems with check-in and security in Manila. NAIA Terminal 2 was a bit spartan but much nicer compared to the dreaded old NAIA 1. Boarding this non-AVOD A330 (filthy inside and out) and departing 30 minutes behind schedule. No blankets or pillows offered. No service except for some peanuts/crackers and coffee/tea/water. Safety video not played and a live manual demo was done. Overhead screens not functioning not even the airshow. Inflight magazine missing from all Economy Class seats. Seats fairly comfortable legroom much better than Cebu Pacific but lesser than Korean Air. Carpets and footrest are filthy. Cebu airport is in a bad state though check-in was not a hassle. Return flight on A330 equipment change from a 747. Same complaints concerning the overhead bins and food/drinks however this time overhead screens were functioning but only airshow was shown and a live safety demo was done in lieu of airing a safety video. In short mediocre (but not poor) experience.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: S Fletcher
content: Generally good service and comfortable flight purchased ticket on Philippine Airlines where the website stated it included a meal. This was a small packet of peanuts and soft drink! This does not represent good value when compared to the other budget airlines operating in the Philippines. Flights are often delayed cancelled or simply amalgamated with flights of their sister airline Phil Air Express.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: S Aitken
content: My husband and I had not travelled on Qantas for a few years despite travelling to UK every year due to previous bad experiences with them. This year we thought we would give the airline another chance. Boy were we sorry. Miserable staff food appalling headsets didn't work. When you can chose multiple airlines to travel overseas from Australia you would think they would at least try to offer a good service. The Asian and Indian airlines can teach them a few tricks.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: S Brennan
content: Flew Business Class Singapore to Melbourne on 10 December leaving at 8.30pm and were less than impressed with Qantas. The staff were excellent but the "meal" if you could call it that was truly appalling. We could choose from about 5 dishes no entrees no salads to go with it. I had a chicken patty in a bun that was it part from being offered a slice of bread. My partner chose a duck stew type of dish which was small and not very tasty. Dessert included a choice of cheese a couple of others and a tub of ice cream! And this was supposed to be the much lauded Neil Perry food. Clearly part of the various economy measures from Mr Joyce along with the disappearing QFF points inability to use the Gold membership in the priority boarding queues etc. We paid a lot of money for our tickets and won't do so again. In contrast we flew to Singapore on Emirates which was a delight in every way from the service aircraft entertainment and food. Qantas entertainment was very limited with only a few movies and quite old TV series. After being a Qantas FF since the late 80s I will be moving to Emirates as soon as my membership runs out.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: Cyril Asuncion
content: SGD-MNL. Check-in was fast and the ground crew were friendly. The plane took of with a 10 min delay. The food was really good and were provided with blankets for the night flight.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: Samuel Samson
content: LAX-MNL-CEB-MNL-LAX. Flight to MAN from LAX was very uneventful food was passable refurbished 747-400. Comfortable seats good friendly service. MAN-CEB on a refurbished 747-400 good service again although they do not let you use your cell phone while waiting for pushback. Return trip from CEB-MAN used the new 777 it was spacious seats were comfortable and aircraft was clean. MNL-LAX plane delayed 30 mins in MAN 747 was not refurbished stuffing coming out of seats plane had to divert to Sapporo Japan to fix ventilation system but the staff were friendly in helping us with the problem.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: A Galacgac
content: Departing for Narita on B777. Smooth check-in. Nice plane. Clean cabin but the seating scheme is awkward! Less choices of magazines. Nice food and attendants however music and movies need updating.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: H Tib
content: MEL-ADL. Short flight though meal was served. Tried the fish and chips thinking this was different to the usual fare however the fish and chips were tepid soggy and inedible. Crew as always on Qantas were hospitable and efficient.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: L Baseley
content: Both my husband and I fly 2 domestic Qantas flights each week for work in Sydney I can honestly say that in the last 6 weeks at least not one flight has run to time. Last week my husbands Monday morning flight was delayed 3 hours they don't notify you of delays which is very inconvenient. Yesterday my flight did three circles over Cessnock before heading to Sydney landing us nearly an hour over time. I think Alan Joyce should take up hotel management as that is where his head is and let someone who is concerned about getting people to where they need to go in a timely fashion and maintaining the services at the airport not worrying about the Qantas lounges there are too many staff doing nothing and the inflight staff are well past their expiry date. When you do one or two flights a year its not concerning but travelling 50 weeks a year it gets a bit up your nose. If only we had practical choices other than Qantas.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: John Philips
content: Aircraft interior was aged and in serious need of upgrade. Inflight entertainment system was old screens were colourless and almost impossible to see. Inflight safety instruction via said screens could not be seen from where I was sitting. Cabin temperature was hot and humid complaints to cabin staff were ignored. Food quality and service was very bad for an international carrier. Service is lax and uninterested.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: W Pollitt
content: PVG-MNL. Nothing great and nothing bad. Typical Philippine airline equipment problem my foot rest had been broken for a while. Entertainment was by a large screen and poor choices of entertainment. It seems it is the little things that dog this airline in addition to the chaos of going to MNL airport.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: Paul Williss
content: Flew Darwin to Brisbane on 767-300 an aircraft used a long time on this route and about to be retired in a couple of weeks. Plane while refurbished was showing its age however still very comfortable in exit row seat. Lunch served on this flight chicken and macaroni while tasty tired looking with the usual bread roll and chocolate bar. If Qantas continues to promote itself as a premier carrier might be an idea to reintroduce a new meal range for its domestic sector. Service was very good on this flight great crew who were pleasant and efficient even scored a free wine. Ice-cream served later. Flight was on time overall good experience.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: Roger Stone
content: SYD-Santiago (SCL)-SYD in Premium Economy. I can only echo other's previous comments on the superb nature of Premium Economy on Qantas' long haul services. My very recent return to SCL could not be faulted especially the incredibly professional cabin service and obvious professionalism of the flight crew on this flight which could be considered one of the 'great airline journeys of the world' and the fact this flight skirts the Antarctic Ice Shelf. Food wine and seating were excellent but the crew's attention to detail was outstanding. I sense Qantas becoming a world leader again in long-haul international flight standards. I only wish Qantas had Premium Economy in its A330s (as Cathay Pacific does).

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: J Selby
content: Domestic business Brisbane to Perth QF589 and 598 business cabins only up to premium economy standards but the crew and service made this trip great highly professional polite and nothing was to much trouble. When they do the refits to these aircraft's I think that Qantas will be number one on the east west route.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: P Pup
content: Sydney to Manila return flight Manila-Melbourne-Sydney. Plane delayed in Sydney due to a problem loading cargo. Aircraft on both trips A340 no personal screens but radio was great and entertainment on overhead screens decent. Plane comfortable and spacious compared to A330. Food was good. More than enough food on return trip. Cabin and lavatory very clean. Staff friendly. Inflight magazine interesting plus exclusive terminal in Manila is convenient. Both flights were pleasant.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: Peter Tan
content: SGP-MNL-LAX. All except one flight was delayed. Did not really like the A320. A bit to small and only had overhead screens. Boeing 747 was a lot better. Interior was new and had personal TV screens. Flight to LAX even took off 10 mins early. Overall I think PAL should just refurbish their airbus A320's to the ones like the Boeing 747. Terminal 2 should also be expanded and renovated.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: Y Barnett
content: I flew to Manila and return to Australia on the 25 Jan. On my trip back to Australia we left Manila at 9 am and arrived Sydney at 8 pm - we had one main meal all day and a snack before we landed Sydney. I paid $2000 for my return airfares to Manila and I ended up hungry. I think we pay enough airfares to be served a decent amount of food. There was also a mix up with my seat I checked in at 5 am only to find somebody else sitting in my seat however in the end staff sorted it out.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: A Kaushik
content: Travelled Y class from SYD to BNE on a 737-800. Flight was on time and quite comfortable. Ordered vegetarian meal was surprised to be served a hot meal on such a short flight. Quality of the food was so-so. Best part of the catering was the Lindt chocolate they handed out after the meal. Crew were friendly and obliging. Would certainly travel with them again.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: T French
content: QF09 from Melbourne to Dubai. This is the first time I have flown Qantas in a number of years and sadly the business class offering has not got any better. Despite being an A380 the seat was broken and was uncomfortable in the upright position. The cabin already looked worn and the side lockers frequently popped open. After the initial boarding drink it was 2.5 hours after take off when the meal was delivered and a second drink finally offered. However they did manage to have time to walk the isles offering duty free for purchase. Considering the flight didn't leave until 23.30 even small things such as socks were not available until approx an hour in to the flight which was quite frustrating for those wanting to get quickly in to the night time routine. The crew were abrupt to the point of being hostile. I can't think of a worse business class experience than Qantas. At least the next leg of the journey was with Emirates but that just highlights how poor the Qantas offering really is.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: N Sutherland
content: MNL-CGK-MNL. Terminal 2 check-in was fine though Jakarta was very slow. On time departures and arrivals on all flights. Food and drinks choices were okay. All in all okay flights the price was nothing special.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: Mark Hurter
content: HKG-MNL MNL-TAG and TAG-MNL. Chose B777-300ER service out of HKG. Seat width a bit limited due to layout but pitch is good. Seat pitch usual A320 layout on domestic flights which is tight in economy. IFE on 777 is good. Good choice for short flight. Overhead screens on domestic sectors. FA's the usual PAL staff. Some (very) friendly and some "only" professional. Could do with consistency on the friendly side. Flights during service provider transition period. But hot meal available on international leg. Choice and quality was good. Better than CX that only serve a bun. No internet check-in available. Overall value for money.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: H Setiawan
content: SIN-MNL-LAX. SIN to MNL on A320 - 5 hours no personal IFE (only drop-down overhead LCD TV) only breads and drinks were available FA's were hiding for majority of the time. Seat was okay nothing special about this flight. MNL to LAX: it was the old un-refurbished 747-400. Ground staff were helpful but the security check line took forever. Even though I had to wait for about 10 hrs in the airport they only gave us two food vouchers. In the 744 no personal IFE they only put the map on the big LCD projector seat was okay meal was not attractive but it was delicious however they served it a bit late. FA was attentive bathroom and cabin were not that clean but still okay. I chose Philippine Airlines because I got very cheap tickets ($ 700 for SIN-LAX return trip).

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: J Rose
content: QF 127 SYD-HKG in premium economy. Absolutely delightful flight. The A380 seasonal service makes a huge difference in flight quality vs either the A330 or B747 service they run most of the year. Extraordinarily comfortable with top notch professional crew and great service.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: L Jarvis
content: SYD-DFW B747. Average flight thought the re-fit of the 747's would be a little nicer than it was. I guess you can't escape the fact that it was an older aircraft. Had an exit row seat - well worth the extra $$$ for a long haul flight. Flight Attendants were good - but not great. Not really interested in you and very rushed and cold in everything they did. Having said that - inflight entertainment was great. All round pleasant experience despite the slight downfalls with aircraft and staff.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: L Jarvis
content: MEL-ADL B737. This was hands-down the best Qantas flight I've had. Better than any domestic - better than any international. The staff were excellent. Friendly and helpful and not stand-offish like some can be. The aircraft was brand new - so it was wonderful. Clean excellent seats lighting and the inflight entertainment was just as good as any international flight! Apart from the dry and disgusting muffin served as our snack - I could not fault it!

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: Michael Moffett
content: Called and reserved window seat and that also fully reclined. I got a window seat just infront of emergency exit. The seat did not recline. Flight was supposed to be non-stop but stopped in Hawaii for over 1 hour to off load and receive passengers. Checked my ticket and printed itinerary it all said non-stop. Good thing for me I had no connecting flight I had to meet in limited time. On the return reserved window seat that reclined however seems they changed the plane from a 747-400 to something that looked like it could only hop from island to island. I had 2 choices and chose the lesser of two evils that still required me to get out of my seat no less than 12 times to allow people to go to and from the rest room and visit friends. There was no stop at Hawaii on the return trip. Seats not made for long haul and very uncomfortable after only 1 hour. Service was mediocre. Food was ok.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: R Silverio
content: Manila to Jakarta on A320. Crew lack courtesy asking passenger to pass on meals to their seat mates. Crew would pass on blankets headphones and even meal boxes on top of people's heads and sometimes a row away from the recipient. Food is awful and is not served in paper boxes. Coffee is now served in styrofoam which is environmentally unfriendly. PAL has downgraded its meal service. I think PAL should now be identified as a budget airline rather than a 3 star airline even if their fares are almost the same as other 5 star airlines.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: S Gonster
content: LAS-MNL MNL-HKG HKG-LAS. Average trip all but one flight arrived on time. Food is so-so. Flight from HKG- MNL loaded and ready 15 mins early but due to ATC delays left almost 1 hr late. Crew were informative and apologetic. Extra $50 for Economy Plus seat worth it on LAS-MNL segment. Transfer from HKG flight in Manila to LAS flight is a test of your patience no direct gate to gate access. You go to the Transfer Desk they take your passport and boarding pass confirm they have located your luggage. Escort you upstairs to passport control through a metal detector and patdown then to the gate for a final passport inspection. Only then are you allowed to proceed to the boarding gate. All this for a same airline flight transfer. We were then an hour late leaving MNL. No seatback IVOD and screens were hard to see.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: A D Storey
content: DFW - SYD rtn in Premium Economy. Flight to Sydney diverted to LAX because a passenger had a heart attack. Crew and ground staff fantastic getting everyone booked and transferred to hotels and back to the airport the next day. Flight back to DFW was "uneventful". Crew service was excellent. Meals and wine selection also of a high standard. Definitely worth the extra money for a comfortable seat.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: J Thurgood
content: Very poor service these days. Used to be a premium airline now very discount. Frequent delays poor customer service (on ground and inflight). Constant cost savings. Very poor complaint resolution process you can expect to receive a reply saying "we trust you will accept our apologies."

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: A Miller
content: Not a fan. Have now made 4 business class trips from LAX-MNL or SFO-MNL. B747s in Business Class are OK but the Airbus is old and the business class seats uncomfortable and sub-standard. The food is horrible. Can't give it a good rating.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: R Sahana
content: CGK-MNL-FUK. The seat was old the plane was dirty with water flowing from the lavatory. There's no pillow or blanket left for me no explanation just they left me freezing. The food is okay on my transit time at NAIA they gave passengers a coupon for breakfast but they don't give any information as to where we can use it. Shocked that there was no personal TV and the headset do not work well.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: T Hundarto
content: QF142 AKL-SYD and QF42 SYD-CGK in economy. Got an exit row seat for the AKL-SYD leg very comfortable and spacious. B737 in great condition. Breakfast was great entertainment was good. SYD-CGK leg was unsatisfactory. A330 uncomfortable seat limited entertainment and unresponsive PTV. Horrible lunch but refreshments were good. Cabin crew were attentive in both flights.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: J Nichol
content: I fly every week Brisbane to Perth return I'm on Gold. Since the start of the year they've slashed FF points and status credits increased ticket prices started charging for exit row seats and are now using hand me down A330 aircraft from Jetstar! Be warned that you most likely will no longer have an inflight entertainment screen in your seat so will have a 5 hour flight with on a small old ceiling screen. Repeatedly these break down and have to be restarted so good luck watching anything. My last flight the meal service was only put up one aisle after 30 minutes the second aisle took 1 hour 45 minutes to get half way down and there was no choice vegetarian only. To sum it up Qantas aren't worth their costs anymore. Due to cost cutting they are insulting the customer by cutting everything possible from the customer service and frequent flyer bonus aspect of their business even though this is exactly where their earnings originate. I'll be letting my QC lapse. I'm disappointed as I had always recommended them to all I work with but now it's the opposite and am warning all others flying this sector (at least) that the value for quality is long long gone. I've already taken 10 staff with me to Virgin as of the first flight of 2015. Recent correspondence with Qantas was basically "Sorry to see you go it's been nice knowing you" which falls in line with their attitude this year. Maybe once customers start to transfer they'll see it cost them more in customer base than they saved in slashing customer service loyalty programs and below par aircraft for the longest transcontinental flights.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: E Milana
content: MNL-CEB-MNL. From MNL check-in was quick and easy until we get to the waiting area of Terminal 2 which was packed with people early in the morning which was understandable considering it was peak season. We were delayed about 20-30 mins. On boarding the A330-300 the seat was fairly comfortable although I think the legroom was a little small. The cabin crew were alright the cabin temperature good enough. On the return check- in was quick and easy delayed again for 30 mins. Before boarding one of PAL's newest B777-300ER the cabin ambience was good and everything felt good the seats were new and comfortable legroom roomy good IFE system this plane is more comfortable than the older A330. Cabin crew were nice and accommodating the second flight was the real value for our money.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: C Kenneally
content: Flew business class 30 November NYC to LA to Melbourne. After travelling 6 weeks in the U.S. It was the nicest experience to board Qantas to such a friendly and welcoming crew. The flight from NY to LA was outstanding with the crew making it a fantastic experience. The flight from L.A. To Melbourne was also nice. It is really noticeable how friendly the Qantas crew are after flying on American carriers. I found the flat beds comfortable with a good variety of seat and bed positions. Having flown Air New Zealand last year the seats on Qantas are superior. Food was ok and agree with other comments not much choice for snacks. Would have also been nice to have drinks offered throughout the flight but when asked for drinks staff were quick to respond and no trouble at all. Would definitely fly Qantas as first choice again. Especially on the reconfigured planes.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: Diana Briscoe
content: We flew to and from Singapore as part of their code share with Finnair. What wonderful service we had the crew were genuinely friendly and nothing seemed too much trouble. Drinks and food were plentiful - extra fruit and water offered during the night. The seats were comfortable.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: M Enrile
content: MNL-SYD return. I was expecting a newer/refurbished plane but unfortunately it was an old one. Food was acceptable nothing special. Toilets were clean. Flights a few minutes delayed. What won me over however were the hospitable flight attendants. Smiling and courteous.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: C Figueroa
content: MNL-PPS on Business Class. Pleasantly surprised when they replaced the aircraft to the A330 for this domestic flight (instead of the A320). Good service with full breakfast in Mabuhay Class. Flight attendants excellent and focused on attending to passengers needs.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: J Slazenger
content: TPE-MNL-VAN. The food is awful seats are old worn out and cramped (Airbus A340). Service is poor with stewardesses and ground staff dismissive if you can get their attention. Shared TV with few screens. They now charge $50 for an exit row seat. If you need to transfer in Manila be warned: the transfer process involves a lot of pointless hanging around.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: John Smith
content: Flew on QF1/QF2 flight from London to Sydney return in October 2014 on the A380 Business Class. The overall experience was average. Pros - complimentary chauffeur pick up/drop off in London/Sydney flight timings (late departure from London early arrival Sydney and vice versa) good IFE with many options pyjamas provided albeit of a sub-standard quality friendly staff albeit service offering strange. Cons - not all seats have direct aisle access the food/beverage service/options are absolutely sub-standard. Offered first drink within 30 minutes after take off and then a top up/glass of wine with dinner. That's it. For a 14 hour flight that is pretty shocking. You can stand up and go ask for another drink but I hate having to do that as it feels like asking someone to do me a favour. The entire Business class cabin shares 4 lavatories of which the rear ones are shared with Premium-Eco. The staff are friendly but are limited to the designed service offering. Qantas has a lot to catch up before they will be on par with the likes of Singapore / Cathay.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: Dhruvin Pathak
content: Once again Flew with Qantas MEL-LAX and LAX-SYD-MEL. What more could one ask for? Great staff A380 Family friendly Best food Kids loved the entertainment onboard Best pilots and even not bad travelling with their partners American Airlines while we were in USA. Missed connecting flight SYD-MEL due to SYD airport being busy but were put on the flight we wanted straight away (more than 6 options given). Only problem with family travelling with kids Qantas and AA would always have the Prams ready for collection at the gate of the aircraft everywhere in the world except in SYD and MEL. No explanation given. Apparently its a special category luggage and have to line up to get with kids waiting for at least 40 minutes. Would definitely keep flying.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: C Down
content: HKG-MEL A330 Business. This is Qantas old business class product with only angled flat beds and a very old IFE system. The seat was quite comfortable in sitting / lounging mode and while the mattress topper made the seat more comfortable in bed mode the angled flat was still not very good for sleeping. The 2-2-2 configuration is also not great as I was in a window seat so getting to the aisle mid-flight in the dark was a bit of a challenge. Food and drink were both excellent and the service provided by the crew was faultless - naturally friendly and professionally efficient. The IFE is not good enough any more with barely any movies on offer and an old poor quality screen to view it on. The Qantas Club lounge in Hong Kong was very nice and not too busy. Overall Qantas do a good job making this old product reasonable however it does not come close to products on offer from competitors. I would recommend Qantas to others but only on their newer aircraft or after the current refit is complete on these aircraft.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: Jonathan Williams
content: If you're flying to Manila you can avoid the awful international terminal by flying Philippine Airlines (PAL). In the past 3 months I have flown twice a month on PAL and over 70% of the time they are late. It's only when you're checked in and sitting in the lounge that the inevitable delays are announced. Even 4 hr delays appear to take PAL by surprise. The aircraft are ok cabins a little shabby.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: M Dunn
content: SFO-MNL. Flight over was not refurbished plane old video monitors broken and one of our seats wouldn't recline however they did change our seats. Food is good but for a westerner would like to see more choices other than traditional plates. Even special meals are geared toward Asian cultures. Went to PAL office in Manilla to complain about being sold a ticket under false advertisement when website shows updated planes. Staff called me after visit to office to tell me the plane on the return would be an updated plane. On the return the seats were electric lie flats great pillows and blankets and the same FA's were on both legs. The FA's have always been professional personable and eager to make your trip enjoyable. Definitely worth the extra money for a long trip.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: E Mabley
content: LAX-SIN via MNL. The LAX-MNL had a 50 min fuel stop in HNL. The flight left LAX late and arrived HNL late but the delay was made up for on the HNL-MNL leg. Boarding was the usual LAX chaos. The mabuhay (business) class seating on the LAX-MNL 744 flight was the airline's new seat which is a sloped 170 degree recliner. The seat was a bit firm due to the newness but comfortable and I was able to get a bit of sleep. The IFE was on par with Delta and United i.e. nothing special. The food was very mediocre but the cabin service was outstanding. The MNL-SIN leg was operated by a 320 with standard short haul business class product. The seats were adequate for a 3.5 hr flight. The food was marginally better than the LAX-MNL leg but cabin service was again outstanding. Overall PR offers very good value considering that their business class fares were significantly cheaper than the competition on the LAX-SIN route.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: Michael Little
content: Melbourne-Sydney and return A330 out and B767 back. The check-in for our outward flight with international connection was smooth and friendly. The flight to Sydney was pleasant apart from the old style seat that offered little back support -- no match for the seat I experienced recently on a Virgin A330. Service and breakfast were good and the plane operated on time. On the return leg there was no business class boarding queue. The seat on the B767 was more comfortable. The service on board was excellent and a tasty early lunch was served. Both lounges were comfortable and offered many options.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: Peter North
content: I flew Brisbane to Melbourne on a weekday lunchtime flight. I did not expect much in the way of lunch for a 2.5 hour flight but I did expect more than a muffin and an apple and a couple of tea. Flight was full - fair enough but my most abiding impression of the service on the flight was the rudeness and perception of seniority of the female flight attendants who looked after the economy cabin. They were on the older side chatted to each other continually and just shoved out the lunchtime morsels on the dinner round. They simply did not seem to recognise the passengers as being worthy of their attention. To be fair baggage came out reasonably quickly at the other end. I paid $239 for flight and would have expected more than I got. No loss for me I have long ago given up on getting any decent value on the QFF programme - so this flight has made me eager to leave for the other side.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: J Topel
content: SFO to MNL Roundtrip. Flying to Manila the sinks in the lavatory was clogged and dirty water was overflowing. The security tape around the toilet had peeled off. The service was substandard. When processing through Manila Airport to return back to SFO three security check points failed to detect two bottles of water bottle of gel lighters and a small pocket knife I used while fishing. The flight back was substandard - 14 hours of no entertainment because both our screens wouldn't work. The flight attendants didn't care and their subsequent customer service support was very poor.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: R Silverio
content: Jakarta to Manila en route Singapore using A320. Seats worn out with audio that does not function. Toilet seems to be run down and not well maintained. Food is good but needs improvement in quantity and quality. Attendants food service is extremely slow. PAL's price is no longer competitive or cheaper compared to other airlines serving the route such as SQ but the latter's service is far better than Philippine Airlines.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: Stephen Yeo
content: MNL-SGP. Was told flight has been delayed till 1800h then was again told flight has been delayed and was finally told at 1845h that flight has been cancelled. The staff was of no help at all and could not answer any questions being asked by passengers. No explanation was given for the cancellation. PAL could have done better in handling such situation.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: Alastair Finch
content: Have flown several times with this airline recently Perth to Adelaide and Alice Springs to Sydney business class and Canberra to Melbourne economy. My wife and I were very impressed staff were brilliant and the business class food on both flights was exceellent. Seats were comfy and entertainment very good. The economy flight was only a short one but the leg room was good and the staff were excellent much older plane with overhead seats only.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: M Ray
content: SYD - LAX business class on an old 747-400. Starting with breakfast in the Qantas First Lounge is always a nice way to start a trip. Seated in row 2 I think has some of the best seats on the plane. The IFE did not work properly and when it did there was a very limited selection. Lunch (or dinner) on the flight was adequate I actually can't remember it so it neither impressed nor repulsed. The flight crew were friendly if a little inattentive. Breakfast healthy and a lovely coffee. The seat for an overnight flight was one of the most uncomfortable I've slept on. Especially compared to CX and similar offerings. All in all it's a tired airline well past it's heyday. I fly 80 or so sectors a year and it seems Qantas is struggling to keep up.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: Daniel Tan
content: MNL-YVR-MNL B777-300ER. Service and inflight entertainment great. Each economy seat has it's own AVOD. Food was good.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: N Villareal
content: MNL-SFO-MNL. Service extremely poor Manila to San Francisco travelling with a child. We were charged US$100 for requesting bassinet seats for our child and the lady beside us travelling with babies wasn't charged at all! We then discovered no bassinets were available. We completed a formal complaint on the plane regarding the overcharge and no response from Philippine Airlines has been forthcoming. On the way back from San Francisco to Manila we were only charged $US50 for seats with a bassinet. The policy isn't consistent! Terminal two in manila travelling to SFO was just appalling - the lines were not organised.

title: Philippine Airlines customer review
author: Mark Hurter
content: MNL-TAG-MNL. Flights on time. Check-in quick and very friendly in MNL not always the case. Cabin crew good but still the same pattern. Men and elder lady FAs friendly. Some of the younger ladies more interested in their appearance than being there for passengers. Snacks fine and choice of water coffee and tea. No OJ anymore but second runs. All in all a good experience for the price paid.

title: Qantas Airways customer review
author: Gunawanto Johannes Tamawidjaja
